text: Ibrat-naak manazir se sabaq lo. Hukm hota hai ke in munkiron se farma dijiye ke zameen mein chal phir kar dekhein toh sahi ke in jaise in se pehle ke logon ka kaisa ibrat-naak anjam hua. Un ki ne'matein chhin gayin, un ke mahalaat ujaar diye gaye, un ki taqat tanha ho gayi, un ke maal tabah kar diye gaye, un ki auladein halak kar di gayin, Allah Ta'ala ke azaab un par se kisi tarah na tale. Aayi hui museebat ko woh na hata sake, noch liye gaye, tabah-o-barbad kar diye gaye, kuch kaam na aaya, koi faida kisi se na pohancha. Allah Ta'ala ko koi hara nahin sakta, use koi amr aajiz nahin kar sakta, us ka koi irada kamyabi se juda nahin, us ka koi hukm kisi se tal nahin sakta. Woh tamam kainat ka aalim hai, woh tamam kaamon par qadir hai. Agar woh apne bandon ke tamam gunahon par pakad karta toh tamam aasmanon wale aur zameenon wale halak ho jate. Janwar aur rizq tak barbad ho jate. Janwaron ko un ke ghonslon aur bhatton mein bhi azaab pohanch jata. Zameen par koi janwar baqi na bachta. Lekin ab dheel diye hue hai, azaabon ko mu'akhar kiye hue hai, waqt aa raha hai ke Qayamat qaim ho jaye aur hisab-kitab shuru ho jaye. Itaat ka badla aur sawab mile. Na-farmani ka azaab aur us par saza ho. Ajal aane ke baad phir takheer nahin milne ki. Allah Azza-wa-Jal apne bandon ko dekh raha hai aur woh bakhoobi dekhne wala hai.

Sirat-e-Mustaqeem ki wazahat. Huroof-e-Muqatta'at jo suraton ke shuru mein hote hain jaise yahan Yaseen hai, unka poora bayan hum Surah Al-Baqarah ki tafsir ke shuru mein kar chuke hain, lehaza ab yahan ise dohrane ki zaroorat nahin. Ba'az logon ne kaha ke Yaseen se murad 'Aye Insaan' hai. Ba'az kehte hain Habshi zaban mein 'Aye Insaan' ke ma'ani mein yeh lafz hai. Koi kehta hai yeh Allah ka naam hai. Phir farmata hai qasam hai muhkam aur mazboot Quran ki, jis ke aas paas bhi batil phatak nahin sakta, ke bil-yaqeen aye Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aap Allah ke sachay Rasool hain, sachay achay mazboot aur umdah seedhay aur saaf deen par aap hain. Yeh raah Allah Rahman-o-Raheem, Sirat-e-Mustaqeem ki hai, isi ka utra hua yeh deen hai jo izzat wala aur mominon par khaas meherbani karne wala hai. Jaise farman hai (وَاِنَّكَ لَـــتَهْدِيْٓ اِلٰى صِرَاطٍ مُّسْتَقِيْمٍ 52؀ۙ) (42. Ash-Shura: 52), toh yaqeenan raah-e-raast ki rehbari karta hai jo us Allah ki seedhi raah hai jo aasman-o-zameen ka maalik hai aur jis ki taraf tamam umoor ka anjaam hai, taake tu Arabon ko dara de jin ke buzurg bhi aagahi se mehroom thay jo mehez ghafil hain. Un ka tanha zikr karna is liye nahin ke dusre is tanbeeh se alag hain. Jaise ke ba'az afraad ke zikr se aam ki nafi nahin hoti. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki ba'asat aam thi, saari duniya ki taraf thi, is ke dalail wazahat-o-tafseel se aayat (قُلْ يٰٓاَيُّھَا النَّاسُ اِنِّىْ رَسُوْلُ اللّٰهِ اِلَيْكُمْ جَمِيْعَۨا) (7. Al-A'raf: 158) ki tafsir mein bayan ho chuke hain. Aksar logon par Allah ke azabon ka qaul saabit ho chuka hai. Unhein toh imaan naseeb nahin hone ka, woh toh tujhe jhutlate hi rahenge.

Shab-e-Hijrat aur kuffar ke sar-e-khaak. Allah Ta'ala farmata hai ke in badnaseebon ka hidayat tak pahunchna bahut mushkil balkay muhaal hai. Yeh toh un logon ki tarah hain jin ke haath gardan par baandh diye jayen aur un ka sar ooncha ja raha ho. Gardan ke zikr ke baad haath ka zikr chhod diya lekin muraad yahi hai ke gardan se mila kar haath baandh diye gaye hain aur sar oonchay hain aur aisa hota hai ke bolne mein ek cheez ka zikr kar ke dusri cheez ko jo usi se samajh li jaati hai us ka zikr chhod dete hain, Arab shairon ke shair mein bhi yeh baat maujood hai. Ghull kehte hi hain dono haathon ko gardan tak pahuncha kar gardan ke saath jakad-band kar dene ko. Isi liye gardan ka zikr kiya aur haathon ka zikr chhod diya. Matlab yeh hai ke hum ne un ke haath un ki gardanon se baandh diye hain is liye woh kisi kaar-e-khair ki taraf haath badha nahin sakte, un ke sar oonchay hain, un ke haath un ke munh par hain, woh har bhalaai karne se qasir hain. Gardanon ke is tauq ke saath hi un ke aagay deewar hai jo haq tasleem karne mein maani hai. Peechay bhi deewar hai yani haq ko maanne mein rukawat hai yani haq se rok hai. Is wajah se taraddud mein pade hote hain, haq ke paas aa nahin sakte. Gumraahiyon mein ghire hue hain. Aankhon par parde pade hue hain. Haq ko dekh hi nahin sakte. Na haq ki taraf raah payen, na haq se faida uthayen. Ibn-e-Abbas R.A ki qiraat mein fa-aghshainahum 'ain' se hai. Yeh ek qisam ki aankh ki beemari hai jo insaan ko naabeena kar deti hai. Pas Islam-o-Imaan ke aur un ke darmiyan chautarfa rukawat hai. Jaise aur aayat mein hai ke jin par tere Rabb ka kalma-e-haq ho chuka hai woh toh imaan laane ke hi nahin agarcheh tu unhein sab aayatein bata de yahan tak ke woh dardnaak azaabon ko khud dekh lein. Jise Allah rok de woh kahan se rokna hata sake. Ek martaba Abu Jahl maloon ne kaha ke agar main Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko dekh loonga toh yun karunga aur yun karunga, is par yeh aayatein utrein. Log usay kehte thay yeh hain Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) lekin usay Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) dikhaai nahin dete thay aur poochta tha kahan hain? Kahan hain? Ek martaba isi maloon ne ek majmay mein kaha tha ke yeh dekho kehta hai ke agar tum is ki tabedaari karoge toh tum baadshah ban jaoge aur marne ke baad khuld-nasheen ho jaoge aur agar tum is ka khilaaf karoge toh yahan zillat ki maut maaray jaoge aur wahan azaabon mein giraftar hoge. Aaj aane toh do. Usi waqt Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) tashreef laye, Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki mutthi mein khaak thi, Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ibtida-e-Surah Yaseen se la-yubsiroon tak padhte hue aa rahe thay. Allah ne un sab ko andha kar diya aur Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) un ke saron par khaak daalte hue tashreef le gaye. In badbakhton ka giroh ka giroh Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke ghar ko gheray hue tha, is ke baad ek sahib ghar se nikle, un se poocha ke tum yahan kaise ghera daale khade ho? Unhon ne kaha Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke intezaar mein, aaj usay zinda nahin chhodenge. Us ne kaha wah wah! Woh toh gaye bhi aur tum sab ke saron par khaak daalte hue nikal gaye hain. Yaqeen na ho toh apne sar jhaado. Ab jo sar jhaade toh waqai khaak nikli.

Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke samne jab Abu Jahl ki yeh baat dohrai gayi toh Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya usne theek kaha, fi-alwaq meri tabedari unke liye dono jahan ki izzat ka ba'is hai aur meri nafarmani unke liye zillat ka mujib hai aur yahi hoga, un par mohar Allah ki lag chuki hai yeh nek baat ka asar nahin lete. Surah Al-Baqarah mein bhi is mazmoon ki ek aayat guzar chuki hai aur aayat mein hai (Innal-lazina haqqat 'alaihim kalimat-u Rabbika la yu'minun) (Surah Yunus: 96), yani jin par kalma-e-azab sabit ho gaya hai unhein iman naseeb nahin hone ka go tu unhein tamam nishaniyan dikha de yahan tak ke woh khud Allah ke azab ko apni aankhon se dekh lein, han teri nasihat un par asar kar sakti hai jo bhali baat ki tabedari karne wale hain. Quran ko manne wale hain, deen dekhne wale, Allah se darne wale hain aur aisi jagah bhi Allah ka khauf rakhte hain jahan koi aur dekhne wala na ho. Woh jante hain ke Allah hamare haal par muttali hai aur hamare af'aal ko dekh raha hai, aise logon ko toh gunahon ki maafi ki aur ajr-e-azim-o-jamil ki khushkhabri pahuncha de. Jaise aur aayat mein hai ke jo log poshidgi mein bhi Allah ka khauf rakhte hain unke liye maghfirat aur sawab-e-kabeer hai, hum hi hain jo murdon ko zindagi dete hain, hum Qayamat ke din unhein nayi zindagi mein paida karne par qadir hain aur is mein ishara hai ke murda dilon ke zinda karne par bhi us Allah ko qudrat hai, woh gumrahon ko bhi rah-e-rast par daal deta hai. Jaise aur maqam par murda dilon ka zikr kar ke Quran-e-Hakim ne farmaya (I'lamu annallaha yuhyil-arda ba'da mautiha, qad bayyanna lakumul-ayati la'allakum ta'qilun) (Surah Al-Hadid: 17), jaan lo ke Allah Ta'ala zameen ko uski maut ke baad zinda kar deta hai, hum ne tumhari samajh boojh ke liye bahut kuch bayan farma diya aur hum unke pehle bheje hue a'maal likh lete hain aur unke aasar bhi, yani jo yeh apne baad baqi chhor aaye. Agar khair baqi chhor aaye hain toh jaza aur saza na payenge. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka farman hai jo shakhs Islam mein nek tariqa jaari kare use iska aur is tariqe ko jo karein un sab ka badla milta hai, lekin unke badle kam ho kar nahin. Aur jo shakhs kisi bure tariqe ko jaari kare iska bojh us par hai aur uska bhi jo is par uske baad karband hon, lekin unka bojh ghata kar nahin. (Muslim). Ek lambi hadith mein iske sath hi qabila-e-Mudar ke chadar posh logon ka waqia bhi hai aur aakhir mein (Inna nahnu nuhyil-mawta wa naktubu ma qaddamu wa asarahum, wa kulla shai'in ahsainahu fi imamin mubin) (Surah Yasin: 12) parhne ka zikr bhi hai. Sahih Muslim Sharif ki ek aur hadith mein hai jab insan mar jata hai toh uske tamam amal kat jate hain magar teen amal: ilm jis se nafa hasil kiya jaye aur nek aulad jo uske liye dua kare aur woh sadqa-e-jariya jo uske baad bhi baqi rahe.

Mujahid se is ayat ki tafsir mein marvi hai ke woh gumrah log jo apni gumrahi baqi chhor jayen. Saeed bin Jubair se marvi hai ke har woh neki badi jise usne jari kiya aur apne baad chhor gaya. Baghawi bhi isi qaul ko pasand farmate hain. Is jumle ki tafsir mein dusra qaul yeh hai ke murad aasar se nishan-e-qadam hain jo ita'at ya ma'asiyat ki taraf uthein. Hazrat Qatada (R.A) farmate hain ae Ibn-e-Adam agar Allah Ta'ala tere kisi fe'l se ghafil hota to tere nishan-e-qadam se ghafil hota jinhein hawa mita deti hai. Lekin Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala is se aur tere kisi amal se ghafil nahin. Tere jitne qadam uski ita'at mein uthte hain aur jitne qadam tu uski ma'asiyat mein uthata hai sab uske han likhe hue hain. Tum mein se jis se ho sake woh Allah ki farman-bardari ke qadam barha le. Isi ma'ani ki bahut si hadishein bhi hain. "Pehli hadis" Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Hazrat Jabir bin Abdullah (R.A) farmate hain Masjid-e-Nabvi ke aas paas kuch makanat khali hue to qabila Banu Salma ne irada kiya ke woh apne mohalle se uth kar yahin qurb-e-masjid ke makanat mein aa basein jab iski khabar Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko hui to Aap ne farmaya mujhe yeh baat maloom hui hai? Kya theek hai? Unhon ne jawab diya kaha han Aap ne do martaba farmaya ae Banu Salma apne makanat mein hi raho tumhare qadam Allah ke han likhe jate hain. "Dusri hadis" Ibn-e-Abi Hatim ki isi riwayat mein hai ke isi bare mein yeh ayat nazil hui aur is qabile ne apna irada badal diya. Bazzar ki isi riwayat mein hai ke Banu Salma ne masjid se apne ghar door hone ki shikayat Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se ki is par yeh ayat utri aur phir woh wahin rehte rahe. Lekin is mein gharabat hai kyunke is mein is ayat ka is bare mein nazil hona bayan hua hai aur yeh puri surat Makki hai. Fallahu A'lam. "Teesri hadis" Ibn-e-Jarir mein Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) se marvi hai ke jin ba'az Ansar ke ghar masjid se door the unhon ne masjid ke qareeb ke gharon mein aana chaha is par yeh ayat utri to unhon ne kaha ab hum in gharon ko nahin chhorein ge. Yeh hadis mauqoof hai. "Chauthi hadis" Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke ek Madani sahabi ka Madina Sharif mein inteqal hua to Aap ne uske janaze ki namaz parha kar farmaya kaash ke yeh apne watan ke siwa kisi aur jagah faut hota kisi ne kaha yeh kyun? Farmaya is liye ke jab koi Musalman ghair-watan mein faut hota hai to uske watan se le kar wahan tak ki zameen tak ka naap kar ke use jannat mein jagah milti hai.

Ibn-e-Jarir mein Hazrat Sabit se riwayat hai ke main Hazrat Anas (R.A) ke sath namaz ke liye masjid ki taraf chala, main jaldi jaldi bade qadmon se chalne laga to aap ne mera hath tham liya aur apne sath ahista ahista halke halke qadmon se le jane lage. Jab hum namaz se farigh hue to aap ne farmaya main Hazrat Zaid bin Sabit (R.A) ke sath masjid ko ja raha tha aur tez tez qadam chal raha tha to aap ne mujh se farmaya, "Ae Anas! Kya tumhein maloom nahin ke yeh nishanat-e-qadam likhe jate hain?" Is qaul se pehle qaul ki mazeed tayeed hoti hai kyunke jab nishan-e-qadam tak likhe jate hain to phailai hui bhalai kyun na likhi jati hogi? Wallahu A'lam. Phir farmaya kul kainat, jamee maujoodat mazboot kitab Lauh-e-Mahfooz mein darj hai, jo Umm-ul-Kitab hai. Yehi tafsir buzurgon se ayat "Yauma Nad'u" ki tafsir mein bhi marwi hai ke un ka namah-e-a'mal jis mein khair-o-shar darj hai. Jaise ayat (Wa wudi'al kitabu fataral mujrimeen - Surah Al-Kahf: 49), aur ayat (Wa wudi'al kitabu wa jee'a bin-nabiyyeena - Surah Az-Zumar: 69), mein hai.

Shab-e-Hijrat aur kuffar ke sar-e-khaak. Allah Ta'ala farmata hai ke in badnaseebon ka hidayat tak pahunchna bahut mushkil balkay muhaal hai. Yeh toh un logon ki tarah hain jin ke haath gardan par baandh diye jayen aur un ka sar ooncha ja raha ho. Gardan ke zikr ke baad haath ka zikr chhod diya lekin muraad yahi hai ke gardan se mila kar haath baandh diye gaye hain aur sar oonchay hain aur aisa hota hai ke bolne mein ek cheez ka zikr kar ke dusri cheez ko jo usi se samajh li jaati hai us ka zikr chhod dete hain, Arab shairon ke shair mein bhi yeh baat maujood hai. Ghull kehte hi hain dono haathon ko gardan tak pahuncha kar gardan ke saath jakad-band kar dene ko. Isi liye gardan ka zikr kiya aur haathon ka zikr chhod diya. Matlab yeh hai ke hum ne un ke haath un ki gardanon se baandh diye hain is liye woh kisi kaar-e-khair ki taraf haath badha nahin sakte, un ke sar oonchay hain, un ke haath un ke munh par hain, woh har bhalaai karne se qasir hain. Gardanon ke is tauq ke saath hi un ke aagay deewar hai jo haq tasleem karne mein maani hai. Peechay bhi deewar hai yani haq ko maanne mein rukawat hai yani haq se rok hai. Is wajah se taraddud mein pade hote hain, haq ke paas aa nahin sakte. Gumraahiyon mein ghire hue hain. Aankhon par parde pade hue hain. Haq ko dekh hi nahin sakte. Na haq ki taraf raah payen, na haq se faida uthayen. Ibn-e-Abbas R.A ki qiraat mein fa-aghshainahum 'ain' se hai. Yeh ek qisam ki aankh ki beemari hai jo insaan ko naabeena kar deti hai. Pas Islam-o-Imaan ke aur un ke darmiyan chautarfa rukawat hai. Jaise aur aayat mein hai ke jin par tere Rabb ka kalma-e-haq ho chuka hai woh toh imaan laane ke hi nahin agarcheh tu unhein sab aayatein bata de yahan tak ke woh dardnaak azaabon ko khud dekh lein. Jise Allah rok de woh kahan se rokna hata sake. Ek martaba Abu Jahl maloon ne kaha ke agar main Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko dekh loonga toh yun karunga aur yun karunga, is par yeh aayatein utrein. Log usay kehte thay yeh hain Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) lekin usay Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) dikhaai nahin dete thay aur poochta tha kahan hain? Kahan hain? Ek martaba isi maloon ne ek majmay mein kaha tha ke yeh dekho kehta hai ke agar tum is ki tabedaari karoge toh tum baadshah ban jaoge aur marne ke baad khuld-nasheen ho jaoge aur agar tum is ka khilaaf karoge toh yahan zillat ki maut maaray jaoge aur wahan azaabon mein giraftar hoge. Aaj aane toh do. Usi waqt Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) tashreef laye, Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki mutthi mein khaak thi, Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ibtida-e-Surah Yaseen se la-yubsiroon tak padhte hue aa rahe thay. Allah ne un sab ko andha kar diya aur Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) un ke saron par khaak daalte hue tashreef le gaye. In badbakhton ka giroh ka giroh Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke ghar ko gheray hue tha, is ke baad ek sahib ghar se nikle, un se poocha ke tum yahan kaise ghera daale khade ho? Unhon ne kaha Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke intezaar mein, aaj usay zinda nahin chhodenge. Us ne kaha wah wah! Woh toh gaye bhi aur tum sab ke saron par khaak daalte hue nikal gaye hain. Yaqeen na ho toh apne sar jhaado. Ab jo sar jhaade toh waqai khaak nikli.

Mujahid se is ayat ki tafsir mein marvi hai ke woh gumrah log jo apni gumrahi baqi chhor jayen. Saeed bin Jubair se marvi hai ke har woh neki badi jise usne jari kiya aur apne baad chhor gaya. Baghawi bhi isi qaul ko pasand farmate hain. Is jumle ki tafsir mein dusra qaul yeh hai ke murad aasar se nishan-e-qadam hain jo ita'at ya ma'asiyat ki taraf uthein. Hazrat Qatada (R.A) farmate hain ae Ibn-e-Adam agar Allah Ta'ala tere kisi fe'l se ghafil hota to tere nishan-e-qadam se ghafil hota jinhein hawa mita deti hai. Lekin Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala is se aur tere kisi amal se ghafil nahin. Tere jitne qadam uski ita'at mein uthte hain aur jitne qadam tu uski ma'asiyat mein uthata hai sab uske han likhe hue hain. Tum mein se jis se ho sake woh Allah ki farman-bardari ke qadam barha le. Isi ma'ani ki bahut si hadishein bhi hain. "Pehli hadis" Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Hazrat Jabir bin Abdullah (R.A) farmate hain Masjid-e-Nabvi ke aas paas kuch makanat khali hue to qabila Banu Salma ne irada kiya ke woh apne mohalle se uth kar yahin qurb-e-masjid ke makanat mein aa basein jab iski khabar Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko hui to Aap ne farmaya mujhe yeh baat maloom hui hai? Kya theek hai? Unhon ne jawab diya kaha han Aap ne do martaba farmaya ae Banu Salma apne makanat mein hi raho tumhare qadam Allah ke han likhe jate hain. "Dusri hadis" Ibn-e-Abi Hatim ki isi riwayat mein hai ke isi bare mein yeh ayat nazil hui aur is qabile ne apna irada badal diya. Lekin is mein gharabat hai kyunke is mein is ayat ka is bare mein nazil hona bayan hua hai aur yeh puri surat Makki hai. Fallahu A'lam. "Teesri hadis" Ibn-e-Jarir mein Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) se marvi hai ke jin ba'az Ansar ke ghar masjid se door the unhon ne masjid ke qareeb ke gharon mein aana chaha is par yeh ayat utri to unhon ne kaha ab hum in gharon ko nahin chhorein ge. Yeh hadis mauqoof hai. "Chauthi hadis" Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke ek Madani sahabi ka Madina Sharif mein inteqal hua to Aap ne uske janaze ki namaz parha kar farmaya kaash ke yeh apne watan ke siwa kisi aur jagah faut hota kisi ne kaha yeh kyun? Farmaya is liye ke jab koi Musalman ghair-watan mein faut hota hai to uske watan se le kar wahan tak ki zameen tak ka naap kar ke use jannat mein jagah milti hai.

Ibn-e-Jarir mein Hazrat Sabit se riwayat hai ke main Hazrat Anas (R.A) ke sath namaz ke liye masjid ki taraf chala, main jaldi jaldi bade qadmon se chalne laga to aap ne mera hath tham liya aur apne sath ahista ahista halke halke qadmon se le jane lage. Jab hum namaz se farigh hue to aap ne farmaya main Hazrat Zaid bin Sabit (R.A) ke sath masjid ko ja raha tha aur tez tez qadam chal raha tha to aap ne mujh se farmaya, "Ae Anas! Kya tumhein maloom nahin ke yeh nishanat-e-qadam likhe jate hain?" Phir farmaya kul kainat, jamee maujoodat mazboot kitab Lauh-e-Mahfooz mein darj hai, jo Umm-ul-Kitab hai. Yehi tafsir buzurgon se ayat "Yauma Nad'u" ki tafsir mein bhi marwi hai ke un ka namah-e-a'mal jis mein khair-o-shar darj hai. Jaise ayat (Wa wudi'al kitabu fataral mujrimeen - Surah Al-Kahf: 49), aur ayat (Wa wudi'al kitabu wa jee'a bin-nabiyyeena - Surah Az-Zumar: 69), mein hai.

Shab-e-Hijrat aur kuffar ke sar-e-khaak. Allah Ta'ala farmata hai ke in badnaseebon ka hidayat tak pahunchna bahut mushkil balkay muhaal hai. Yeh toh un logon ki tarah hain jin ke haath gardan par baandh diye jayen aur un ka sar ooncha ja raha ho. Gardan ke zikr ke baad haath ka zikr chhod diya lekin muraad yahi hai ke gardan se mila kar haath baandh diye gaye hain aur sar oonchay hain aur aisa hota hai ke bolne mein ek cheez ka zikr kar ke dusri cheez ko jo usi se samajh li jaati hai us ka zikr chhod dete hain, Arab shairon ke shair mein bhi yeh baat maujood hai. Ghull kehte hi hain dono haathon ko gardan tak pahuncha kar gardan ke saath jakad-band kar dene ko. Isi liye gardan ka zikr kiya aur haathon ka zikr chhod diya. Gardanon ke is tauq ke saath hi un ke aagay deewar hai jo haq tasleem karne mein maani hai. Peechay bhi deewar hai yani haq ko maanne mein rukawat hai yani haq se rok hai. Is wajah se taraddud mein pade hote hain, haq ke paas aa nahin sakte. Gumraahiyon mein ghire hue hain. Aankhon par parde pade hue hain. Haq ko dekh hi nahin sakte. Na haq ki taraf raah payen, na haq se faida uthayen. Ibn-e-Abbas R.A ki qiraat mein fa-aghshainahum 'ain' se hai. Yeh ek qisam ki aankh ki beemari hai jo insaan ko naabeena kar deti hai. Pas Islam-o-Imaan ke aur un ke darmiyan chautarfa rukawat hai. Jaise aur aayat mein hai ke jin par tere Rabb ka kalma-e-haq ho chuka hai woh toh imaan laane ke hi nahin agarcheh tu unhein sab aayatein bata de yahan tak ke woh dardnaak azaabon ko khud dekh lein. Ek martaba Abu Jahl maloon ne kaha ke agar main Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko dekh loonga toh yun karunga aur yun karunga, is par yeh aayatein utrein. Ek martaba isi maloon ne ek majmay mein kaha tha ke yeh dekho kehta hai ke agar tum is ki tabedaari karoge toh tum baadshah ban jaoge aur marne ke baad khuld-nasheen ho jaoge aur agar tum is ka khilaaf karoge toh yahan zillat ki maut maaray jaoge aur wahan azaabon mein giraftar hoge. Usi waqt Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) tashreef laye, Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki mutthi mein khaak thi, Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ibtida-e-Surah Yaseen se la-yubsiroon tak padhte hue aa rahe thay. Unhon ne kaha Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke intezaar mein, aaj usay zinda nahin chhodenge. Us ne kaha wah wah! Sahih Muslim Sharif ki ek aur hadith mein hai jab insan mar jata hai toh uske tamam amal kat jate hain magar teen amal: ilm jis se nafa hasil kiya jaye aur nek aulad jo uske liye dua kare aur woh sadqa-e-jariya jo uske baad bhi baqi rahe.

Mujahid se is ayat ki tafsir mein marvi hai ke woh gumrah log jo apni gumrahi baqi chhor jayen. Saeed bin Jubair se marvi hai ke har woh neki badi jise usne jari kiya aur apne baad chhor gaya. Baghawi bhi isi qaul ko pasand farmate hain. Is jumle ki tafsir mein dusra qaul yeh hai ke murad aasar se nishan-e-qadam hain jo ita'at ya ma'asiyat ki taraf uthein. Hazrat Qatada (R.A) farmate hain ae Ibn-e-Adam agar Allah Ta'ala tere kisi fe'l se ghafil hota to tere nishan-e-qadam se ghafil hota jinhein hawa mita deti hai. Lekin Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala is se aur tere kisi amal se ghafil nahin. Tere jitne qadam uski ita'at mein uthte hain aur jitne qadam tu uski ma'asiyat mein uthata hai sab uske han likhe hue hain. Tum mein se jis se ho sake woh Allah ki farman-bardari ke qadam barha le. Isi ma'ani ki bahut si hadishein bhi hain. "Pehli hadis" Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Hazrat Jabir bin Abdullah (R.A) farmate hain Masjid-e-Nabvi ke aas paas kuch makanat khali hue to qabila Banu Salma ne irada kiya ke woh apne mohalle se uth kar yahin qurb-e-masjid ke makanat mein aa basein jab iski khabar Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko hui to Aap ne farmaya mujhe yeh baat maloom hui hai? Kya theek hai? Unhon ne jawab diya kaha han Aap ne do martaba farmaya ae Banu Salma apne makanat mein hi raho tumhare qadam Allah ke han likhe jate hain. "Dusri hadis" Ibn-e-Abi Hatim ki isi riwayat mein hai ke isi bare mein yeh ayat nazil hui aur is qabile ne apna irada badal diya. Bazzar ki isi riwayat mein hai ke Banu Salma ne masjid se apne ghar door hone ki shikayat Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se ki is par yeh ayat utri aur phir woh wahin rehte rahe. Lekin is mein gharabat hai kyunke is mein is ayat ka is bare mein nazil hona bayan hua hai aur yeh puri surat Makki hai. Fallahu A'lam. "Teesri hadis" Ibn-e-Jarir mein Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) se marvi hai ke jin ba'az Ansar ke ghar masjid se door the unhon ne masjid ke qareeb ke gharon mein aana chaha is par yeh ayat utri to unhon ne kaha ab hum in gharon ko nahin chhorein ge. Yeh hadis mauqoof hai. "Chauthi hadis" Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke ek Madani sahabi ka Madina Sharif mein inteqal hua to Aap ne uske janaze ki namaz parha kar farmaya kaash ke yeh apne watan ke siwa kisi aur jagah faut hota kisi ne kaha yeh kyun? Farmaya is liye ke jab koi Musalman ghair-watan mein faut hota hai to uske watan se le kar wahan tak ki zameen tak ka naap kar ke use jannat mein jagah milti hai.

Ibn-e-Jarir mein Hazrat Sabit se riwayat hai ke main Hazrat Anas (R.A) ke sath namaz ke liye masjid ki taraf chala, main jaldi jaldi bade qadmon se chalne laga to aap ne mera hath tham liya aur apne sath ahista ahista halke halke qadmon se le jane lage. Jab hum namaz se farigh hue to aap ne farmaya main Hazrat Zaid bin Sabit (R.A) ke sath masjid ko ja raha tha aur tez tez qadam chal raha tha to aap ne mujh se farmaya, "Ae Anas! Kya tumhein maloom nahin ke yeh nishanat-e-qadam likhe jate hain?" Is qaul se pehle qaul ki mazeed tayeed hoti hai kyunke jab nishan-e-qadam tak likhe jate hain to phailai hui bhalai kyun na likhi jati hogi? Wallahu A'lam. Phir farmaya kul kainat, jamee maujoodat mazboot kitab Lauh-e-Mahfooz mein darj hai, jo Umm-ul-Kitab hai. Yehi tafsir buzurgon se ayat "Yauma Nad'u" ki tafsir mein bhi marwi hai ke un ka namah-e-a'mal jis mein khair-o-shar darj hai. Jaise ayat (Wa wudi'al kitabu fataral mujrimeen - Surah Al-Kahf: 49), aur ayat (Wa wudi'al kitabu wa jee'a bin-nabiyyeena - Surah Az-Zumar: 69), mein hai.

Ek qissa-e-pareena. Allah Ta'ala apne Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko hukum farma raha hai ke aap apni qoum ke sath un sabiqah logon ka qissa bayan farmayiye jinhon ne un se pehle apne rasoolon ko un ki tarah jhutlaya tha. Yeh waqea shehar-e-Antakiyah ka hai. Wahan ke badshah ka naam Antiyakhs tha us ke baap aur dada ka naam bhi yahi tha yeh sab raja parja but-parast thay. Un ke paas Allah ke teen rasool aaye. Sadiq, Sadooq aur Shaloome. Allah ke durood-o-salam un par nazil hon. Lekin un badnaseebon ne sab ko jhutlaya. Anqareeb yeh bayan bhi aa raha hai ke baaz buzurgon ne ise nahin mana ke yeh waqea Antakiyah ka ho, pehle to us ke paas do rasool aaye unhon ne unhein nahin mana un do ki tayeed mein phir teesre Nabi aaye, pehle do rasoolon ka naam Shamoon aur Yuhanna tha aur teesre rasool ka naam Bolus tha. Un sab ne kaha ke hum Allah ke bheje hue hain. Jis ne tumhein paida kiya hai us ne hamari marifat tumhein hukum bheja hai ke tum us ke siwa kisi aur ki ibadat na karo. Hazrat Qatadah bin Di'amah (R.H) ka khayal hai ke yeh teeno buzurg Janab-e-Masih (A.S) ke bheje hue thay, basti ke un logon ne jawab diya ke tum to hum jaise hi insaan ho phir kya wajah? Ke tumhari taraf Allah ki wahi aaye aur hamari taraf na aaye? Haan agar tum rasool hote to chahiye tha ke tum farishte hote. Aksar kuffar ne yahi shuba apne apne zamane ke paighambaron ke samne pesh kiya tha. Jaise Allah Azzawajal ka irshad hai (Zalika bi-annahu kanat ta'tihim rusuluhum bil-bayyinati faqalu abasharun yahdunana fakafaru wa tawallaw wastaghanallahu wallahu ghaniyyun hamid) (Surah At-Taghabun: 6) yani logon ke paas rasool aaye aur unhon ne jawab diya ke kya insaan hamare hadi ban kar aa gaye? Aur aayat mein hai al-kh, yani tum to hum jaise insaan hi ho tum sirf yeh chahte ho ke hamain apne baap dadon ke maboodon se rok do. Jao koi khula ghalba le kar aao. Aur jagah Quran-e-Pak mein hai yani kafiron ne kaha ke agar tum ne apne jaise insanon ki tabedari ki to yaqeenan tum bade hi ghate mein pad gaye. Is se bhi zyada wazahat ke sath aayat (Wa ma mana'an-nasa an yu'minu iz ja'ahumul huda illa an qalu aba'asallahu basharan rasula) (Surah Al-Isra: 94) mein is ka bayan hai. Yahi un logon ne bhi un teeno nabiyon se kaha ke tum to hum jaise insaan hi ho aur haqeeqat mein Allah ne to kuch bhi nazil nahin farmaya tum yunhi ghalat malat keh rahe ho, paighambaron ne jawab diya ke Allah khoob janta hai ke hum us ke sachay rasool hain. Agar hum jhootay hote to Allah par jhoot bandhne ki saza hamain Allah Ta'ala de deta lekin tum dekhoge ke woh hamari madad kare ga aur hamain izzat ata farmaye ga.

Us waqt tumhein khud roshan hojaye ga ke kaun shakhs ba-aitibar-e-anjam ke achha raha? Jaise aur jagah irshad hai (Qul kafa billahi baini wa bainakum shahida, ya'lamu ma fis-samawati wal-ard, wallazina amanu bil-batili wa kafaru billahi, ula'ika humul-khasirun) (Surah Al-Ankabut: 52), mere tumhare darmiyan Allah ki shahadat kafi hai. Jaise aur jagah irshad hai (Qul kafa billahi baini wa bainakum shahida, ya'lamu ma fis-samawati wal-ard, wallazina amanu bil-batili wa kafaru billahi, ula'ika humul-khasirun) (Surah Al-Ankabut: 52), mere tumhare darmiyan Allah ki shahadat kafi hai. Woh to aasman-o-zameen ke ghaib janta hai. Batil par iman rakhne wale aur Allah se kufr karne wale hi nuqsan-yafta hain, suno hamare zimme to sirf tabligh hai, mano ge tumhara bhala hai, na mano ge to pachtao ge, hamara kuch nahin bigaro ge, kal apne kiye ka khamyaza bhugto ge.

Anbiya-o-Rusul se kafiron ka rawayya. Un kafiron ne un rasoolon se kaha ke tumhare aane se hamain koi barkat-o-khairiyat to mili nahin, balkay aur burai aur badi pahunchi. Tum ho hi badshagun aur tum jahan jaoge balayen barsengi. Suno agar tum apne is tareeqay se baaz na aaye aur yahi kehte rahe to hum tumhain sangsar kar denge aur sakht alamnak sazain denge. Rasoolon ne jawab diya ke tum khud badfitrat ho, tumhare aamal hi bure hain aur isi wajah se tum par museebatain aati hain. Jaisa karoge waisa bharoge. Yahi baat Firauniyon ne Hazrat Musa (A.S) aur un ki qoum ke mominon se kahi thi. Jab unhain koi rahat milti to kehte hum to is ke mustahiq hi thay aur agar koi ranj pahunchta to Hazrat Musa (A.S) aur mominon ki badshaguni par usay mahmool karte. Jis ke jawab mein Janab-e-Bari ne farmaya yani un ki museebaton ki wajah un ke bad-aamal hain jin ka wabaal hamari janib se unhain pahunch raha hai. Qoum-e-Saleh ne bhi apne Nabi se yahi kaha tha aur yahi jawab paya tha. Khud Janab-e-Paighambar-e-Aakhir-uz-Zaman Hazrat Muhammad Mustafa (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se bhi yahi kaha gaya hai jaisa ke Allah Azza-wa-Jal ka irshad hai yani agar in kafiron ko koi nafa hota hai to kehte hain yeh Allah ki taraf se hai aur agar koi nuqsan hota hai to kehte hain yeh teri taraf se hai. Keh dijiye ke sab kuch Allah ki janib se hai. Inhain kya ho gaya hai ke in se yeh baat bhi nahin samjhi jati? Phir farmata hai ke sirf is wajah se ke hum ne tumhain nasihat ki, tumhari khair-khwahi ki, tumhain bhali raah samjhai, tumhain Allah ki tauheed ki taraf rehnumai ki, tumhain ikhlas-o-ibadat ke tareeqay sikhaye, tum hamain manhoos samajhne lage? Aur hamain is tarah darane dhamkane lage? Aur khaufzada karne lage? Aur muqablay par utar aaye? Haqeeqat yeh hai ke tum fazool kharch log ho, hudood-e-Ilahiya se tajawuz kar jate ho. Hamain dekho ke hum tumhari bhalai chahen, tumhain dekho ke tum hum se burai samjho. Batao to bhala yeh koi insaaf ki baat hai? Afsos tum insaaf ke dairay se nikal gaye.

Muballigh-e-Haq shaheed kardiya. Marwi hai ke is basti ke log yahan tak sarkash hogaye ke unhon ne posheeda taur par nabiyon ke qatl ka irada karliya. Ek Musalman shakhs jo is basti ke aakhri hissay mein rehta tha jis ka naam Habib tha aur rassay ka kaam karta tha, tha bhi bimar, juzam ki bimari thi, bahut sakhi aadmi tha. Jo kamata tha us ka aadha hissa Allah ki raah mein khairaat kardiya karta tha. Dil ka narm aur fitrat ka achha tha. Logon se alag thalag ek ghaar mein baith kar Allah Azzawajal ki ibadat kiya karta tha. Us ne jab apni qoum ke is bad iraday ko kisi tarah maloom kiya to us se sabr na hosaka daurta bhagta aaya. Baaz kehte hain yeh barhai thay. Ek qaul hai ke yeh dhobi thay. Umar bin Hakam farmate hain jooti ganthne wale thay. Allah un par raham kare. Unhon ne aa kar apni qoum ko samjhana shuru kiya ke tum in rasoolon ki tabedari karo. Un ka kaha mano. Un ki raah chalo, dekho to yeh apna koi faida nahin kar rahe yeh tum se tableegh-e-risalat par koi badla nahin maangte. Apni khair khwahi ki koi ujrat tum se talab nahin kar rahe. Dard-e-dil se tumhein Allah ki tauheed ki dawat de rahe hain aur seedhay aur sachay raastay ki rehnumai kar rahe hain. Khud bhi isi raah par chal rahe hain. Tumhein zaroor in ki dawat par labbaik kehna chahiye aur in ki itaat karni chahiye. Lekin qoum ne in ki ek na suni balkay unhein shaheed kardiya. Razi Allahu Anhu wa Arzah.

Rah-e-Haq ka Shaheed. Woh nek-bakht shakhs jo Allah ke Rasoolon ki takzeeb-o-tardeed aur tauheen hoti dekh kar daura hua aaya tha aur jis ne apni qaum ko Nabiyon ki tabedari ki raghbat dilayi thi woh ab apne amal aur aqeeday ko un ke samne pesh kar raha hai aur unhein haqeeqat se aagah kar ke iman ki dawat de raha hai, toh kehta hai ke main toh sirf apne Khaliq-o-Malik Allah Wahdahu La Sharika Lahu ki qudrat ki hi ibadat karta hoon jabke sirf usi ne mujhe paida kiya hai toh main us ki ibadat kyun na karoon? Phir yeh nahin ke ab hum us ki qudrat se nikal gaye hain? Us se ab hamara koi talluq nahin raha ho? Nahin balkay sab ke sab laut kar phir us ke samne jama hone wale hain. Us waqt woh har bhalai burai ka badla de ga. Yeh kaisi sharm ki baat hai ke main us Khaliq-e-Waqar ko chhor kar auron ko poojoon jo na toh yeh taqat rakhein ke Allah Ta'ala ki taraf se aayi hui kisi museebat ko mujh par se taal dein, na yeh ke un ke kehne sunne ki wajah se mujhe koi burai pohanche, Allah agar mujhe koi zarar pohanchana chahe toh yeh use dafa nahin kar sakte rok nahin sakte na mujhe us se bacha sakte hain, agar main aise kamzoron ki ibadat karne lagoon toh mujh se barh kar gumrah aur behka hua aur kaun hoga? Phir toh na sirf mujhe balkay duniya ke har bhale insan ko meri gumrahi khul jaye gi. Meri qaum ke logo! Apne jis haqeeqi Mabood aur Parwardigar se tum munkir huye ho. Suno main toh us ki zaat par iman rakhta hoon aur yeh bhi ma'ani is aayat ke ho sakte hain ke us Allah ke banday mard-e-saleh ne ab apni qaum se rogardani kar ke Allah ke un Rasoolon se yeh kaha ho ke Allah ke Paighambaro! Tum mere iman ke gawah rehna! Main us Allah ki zaat par iman laya jis ne tumhein bar-haq Rasool bana kar bheja hai, pas goya yeh apne iman par Allah ke Rasoolon ko gawah bana raha hai. Yeh qaul ba-nisbat aglay qaul ke bhi zyada wazeh hai Wallahu A'alam. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) waghaira farmate hain ke yeh buzurg itna hi kehne paye the ke tamam kuffar pal pare aur zado-kob karne lage. Kaun tha jo unhein bachata? Pathar marte marte unhein usi waqt fil-faur shaheed kar diya (Razi Allahu Anhu wa Arzah). Yeh Allah ke banday yeh sachay Wali-e-Allah pathar kha rahe the lekin zaban se yahi kahe ja rahe the ke Allah meri qaum ko hidayat kar yeh jante nahin.

Zalimon ke liye Azaab-e-Ilahi. Hazrat Ibn-e-Masood R.A farmate hain ke in kuffar ne us momin-e-kamil ko buri tarah mara peeta, use gira kar uske pet par chadh baithe aur pairon se use rondne lage yahan tak ke uski aanten uske peeche ke raaste se bahar nikal aayin, isi waqt Allah ki taraf se use Jannat ki khushkhabri sunayi gayi, use Allah Ta'ala ne duniya ke ranj-o-gham se azaad kar diya aur aman-o-chain ke saath Jannat mein pahuncha diya. Unki shahadat se Allah khush hua, Jannat unke liye khol di gayi aur dakhla ki ijazat mil gayi, apne sawab-o-ajar ko, izzat-o-ikram ko dekh kar phir uski zaban se nikal gaya: "Kaash ke meri qoum yeh jaan leti ke mujhe mere Rab ne bakhsh diya aur mera bada hi ikram kiya." Fi-al-waqai momin sab ke khair-khwah hote hain, woh dhoke-baaz aur bad-khwah nahin hote. Dekhiye us Allah wale shakhs ne zindagi mein bhi qoum ki khair-khwahi ki aur baad-e-marg bhi unka khair-khwah raha. Yeh bhi matlab hai ke woh kehta hai kaash ke meri qoum yeh jaan leti ke mujhe kis sabab se mere Rab ne bakhsha aur kyun meri izzat ki, toh la-mahalah woh bhi is cheez ko hasil karne ki koshish karti, Allah par iman lati aur Rasoolon ki pairwi karti, Allah un par rahmat kare aur un se khush rahe. Dekho toh qoum ki hidayat ke kis qadar khwahish-mand thay. Hazrat Urwa bin Masood Saqafi R.A ne Janab-e-Rasool Allah ﷺ ki khidmat mein arz kiya ke Huzoor agar ijazat dein toh main apni qoum mein tableegh-e-deen ke liye jaaun aur unhein dawat-e-Islam doon? Aap ﷺ ne farmaya aisa na ho ke woh tumhein qatl kar dein? Jawab diya ke Huzoor ﷺ is ka toh khayal tak nahin. Unhein mujh se is qadar ulfat-o-aqeedat hai ke main soya hua hoon toh woh mujhe jagayenge bhi nahin, Aap ﷺ ne farmaya achha phir jaiye. Yeh chale, jab Laat-o-Uzza ke buton ke paas se unka guzar hua toh kehne lage ab tumhari shamat aa gayi. Qabeela Saqeef bigad baitha, unhon ne kehna shuru kiya ke aye meri qoum ke logo! Tum in buton ko tark karo, yeh Laat-o-Uzza dar-asal koi cheez nahin, Islam qabool karo toh salamti hasil hogi. Aye mere bhai-bandu! Yaqeen mano ke yeh but kuch haqeeqat nahin rakhte, saari bhalayi Islam mein hai waghera. Abhi toh teen hi martaba sirf is kalma ko dohraya tha jab ek bad-naseeb tan-jale ne door se ek hi teer chalaya jo rag-e-akhal par laga aur isi waqt shaheed ho gaye. Huzoor ﷺ ke paas jab yeh khabar pahunchi toh Aap ﷺ ne farmaya yeh aisa hi tha jaise Surah Yaseen wala jis ne kaha tha kaash ke meri qoum meri maghfirat-o-izzat ko jaan leti. Hazrat Ka'ab Ahbar R.A ke paas jab Habeeb bin Zaid bin Aasim R.A ka zikr aaya jo qabeela Banu Mazin bin Najjar se thay jinhein Yamama mein Musailama Kazzab maloon ne shaheed kar diya tha toh Aap R.A ne farmaya Allah ki qasam yeh Habeeb bhi usi Habeeb ki tarah thay jin ka zikr Surah Yaseen mein hai, un se is kazzab ne Huzoor ﷺ ke baare mein daryaft kiya toh Aap R.A ne farmaya beshak woh Allah ke Rasool ﷺ hain, us ne kaha meri nisbat bhi toh gawahi deta hai ke main Rasool-e-Allah hoon? Toh Hazrat Habeeb R.A ne farmaya main nahin sunta.

Us ne kaha Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki nisbat toh kya kehta hai? Jawab diya ke main un ki sachi risalat ko maanta hoon, us ne phir poocha meri risalat ki nisbat kya kehta hai? Ek martaba poochta aur un ke is jawab par ek uzw-e-badan katwa deta, phir poochta, phir yahi jawab paata, phir ek uzw-e-badan katwata, isi tarah jism ka ek ek jod katwa diya aur woh apne sache Islam par aakhri dam tak qaim rahe aur jo jawab pehle tha wahi aakhir tak raha yahan tak ke shaheed ho gaye. Razi Allahu Anhu wa Arzah. Is ke baad un logon par jo Allah ka ghazab nazil hua aur jis azab se woh gharat kar diye gaye us ka zikr ho raha hai, chunke unhon ne Allah ke rasoolon ko jhutlaya, Allah ke wali ko qatl kiya is liye un par azab utra aur halak kar diye gaye, lekin unhein barbad karne ke liye Allah ne toh koi lashkar aasman se bheja na koi khaas ehtimam karna pada na kisi bade se bade kaam ke liye us ki zaroorat, us ka toh sirf hukm kar dena kaafi hai, na unhein is ke baad koi tanbeeh ki gayi na un par farishtay utaray gaye, balkay bila-mohlat azab mein pakad liye gaye aur baghair is ke ke koi naam lene wala paani dene wala ho, awwal se aakhir tak ek ek karke sab ke sab fana ke ghaat utaar diye gaye. Jibraeel (A.S / Alaihis Salam) aaye aur un ke shehar Antakiya ke darwaze ki chaukhat thaam kar is zor se ek aawaz lagayi ke kaleje paash paash ho gaye, dil ud gaye aur roohein parwaz kar gayin. Hazrat Qatada (R.H / Rahimahullah) se marwi hai ke un logon ke paas jo teenon rasool aaye thay yeh Hazrat Isa (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ke bheje hue qasid thay, lekin is mein qadray kalam hai, awwalan toh yeh ke qissay ke zahir se yeh maloom hota hai ke woh mustaqil rasool thay. Farman hai (Iza arsalna ilaihimus-snaini fakazzabuhuma fa'azzazna bi-salisin faqalu inna ilaikum mursaloon) (Surah Ya-Sin: 14), jabke hum ne un ki taraf do rasool bheje jab unhon ne un dono ko jhutlaya toh hum ne un ki madad ke liye teesra rasool bheja. Phir Allah ke yeh rasool Ahl-e-Antakiya se kehte hain (Inna ilaikum mursaloon) (Surah Ya-Sin: 14), yani hum tumhari taraf rasool hain. Pas agar yeh teenon Hazrat Isa (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ke hawariyon mein se Hazrat Isa (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ke bheje hue hote toh unhein yeh kehna munasib na tha balkay woh koi aisa jumla kehte jis se maloom ho jaata ke yeh Hazrat Isa (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ke qasid hain, Wallahu A'lam. Phir yeh bhi ek qareena hai ke kuffar-e-Antakiya un ke jawab mein kehte hain (In antum illa basharum-misluna turiduna an tasudduna amma kana ya'budu aba'una fa'tuna bisultanim-mubeen) (Surah Ibrahim: 10), tum toh hum hi jaise insaan ho, dekh lo yeh kalma kuffar hamesha rasoolon ko hi kehte rahe.

Agar woh hawariyon mein se hote toh unka mustaqil dawa-e-risalat ka tha hi nahin, phir unhein yeh log yeh ilzam hi kyun dete? Saniyan Ahl-e-Antakiya ki taraf Hazrat-e-Masih (A.S) ke qasid gaye the aur us waqt us basti ke log un par iman laye the, balkay yahi woh basti hai jo sari ki sari Janab-e-Masih (A.S) par iman layi, isi liye nasraniyon ke woh char shehar jo muqaddas samjhe jate hain un mein ek yeh bhi hai. Bait-ul-Muqaddas ki buzurgi ke woh qail is liye ke woh Hazrat-e-Masih (A.S) ka shehar hai aur Antakiya ko hurmat wala shehar is liye kehte hain ke sab se pehle yahin ke log Hazrat-e-Masih (A.S) par iman laye. Aur Iskandariya ki azmat ki wajah yeh hai ke unhon ne apne mazhabi ohdedaron ke taqarrur par ijma kiya. Aur Rumiya ki hurmat ke qail is wajah se hain ke Shah Qustuntuniya ka shehar yahi hai aur isi badshah ne unke deen ki imdad ki thi aur yahin unke tabarrukat ko Rumiya se yahan la rakha. Sa'ad bin Batriq waghera nasrani muwarrikheen ki kitabon mein yeh sab waqiyat mazkoor hain. Musalman muwarrikheen ne bhi yahi likha hai, pas maloom hua ke Antakiya walon ne Hazrat-e-Isa (A.S) ke qasidon ki toh maan li thi aur yahan bayan hai ke unhon ne na mani aur un par azab-e-Ilahi aaya aur tehas nehas kar diye gaye, toh sabit hua ke yeh waqia aur hai. Yeh rasool mustaqil risalat par mamoor the, unhon ne na mana jis par unhein saza hui aur woh benishan kar diye gaye aur chiragh-e-sehari ki tarah bujha diye gaye, Wallahu A'lam. Saniyan Antakiya walon ka qissa jo Hazrat-e-Isa (A.S) ke hawariyon ke sath waqoo mein aaya woh qatan Taurat ke utarne ke baad ka hai aur Hazrat Abu Saeed Khudri (R.A) aur salaf ki ek jamaat se manqool hai ke Taurat ke nazil ho chukne ke baad kisi basti ko Allah Ta'ala ne apne asmani azab se bilkul barbad nahin kiya balkay mominon ko kafiron se jihad karne ka hukum de kar kuffar ko neecha dikhaya hai. Haan, yeh bhi ho sakta hai ke Antakiya nami koi shehar aur bhi ho aur yeh waqia wahan ka ho. Is liye ke jo Antakiya mashhoor hai uska azab-e-Ilahi se neest-o-nabood hona mashhoor nahin hua, na toh nasraniyat ke zamane mein aur na us se pehle.

Wallahu Subhanu wa Ta'ala A'lam, yeh bhi yaad rahe ke Tabrani ki ek marfu' hadith mein hai ke duniya mein teen hi shakhs sabqat karne mein sab se aage nikal gaye hain, Hazrat Musa (A.S) ki taraf sabqat karne wale toh Hazrat Yusha bin Nun (A.S) thay aur Hazrat Isa (A.S) ki taraf sabqat karne wale woh shakhs thay jin ka zikr Surah Yaseen mein hai aur Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki khidmat mein aage barhne wale Hazrat Ali bin Abi Talib (R.A) thay, yeh hadith bilkul munkar hai. Sirf Hussain Ash'ar isay riwayat karta hai aur woh Shia hai aur matrook hai. Wallahu Subhanu wa Ta'ala A'lam bis-sawab.

Hazrat Qatada (R.H / Rahimahullah) se marwi hai ke un logon ke paas jo teenon rasool aaye thay yeh Hazrat Isa (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ke bheje hue qasid thay, lekin is mein qadray kalam hai, awwalan toh yeh ke qissay ke zahir se yeh maloom hota hai ke woh mustaqil rasool thay. Farman hai (Iza arsalna ilaihimus-snaini fakazzabuhuma fa'azzazna bi-salisin faqalu inna ilaikum mursaloon) (Surah Ya-Sin: 14), jabke hum ne un ki taraf do rasool bheje jab unhon ne un dono ko jhutlaya toh hum ne un ki madad ke liye teesra rasool bheja. Phir Allah ke yeh rasool Ahl-e-Antakiya se kehte hain (Inna ilaikum mursaloon) (Surah Ya-Sin: 14), yani hum tumhari taraf rasool hain. Pas agar yeh teenon Hazrat Isa (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ke hawariyon mein se Hazrat Isa (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ke bheje hue hote toh unhein yeh kehna munasib na tha balkay woh koi aisa jumla kehte jis se maloom ho jaata ke yeh Hazrat Isa (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ke qasid hain, Wallahu A'lam. Phir yeh bhi ek qareena hai ke kuffar-e-Antakiya un ke jawab mein kehte hain (In antum illa basharum-misluna turiduna an tasudduna amma kana ya'budu aba'una fa'tuna bisultanim-mubeen) (Surah Ibrahim: 10), tum toh hum hi jaise insaan ho, dekh lo yeh kalma kuffar hamesha rasoolon ko hi kehte rahe.

Agar woh hawariyon mein se hote toh unka mustaqil dawa-e-risalat ka tha hi nahin, phir unhein yeh log yeh ilzam hi kyun dete? Saniyan Ahl-e-Antakiya ki taraf Hazrat-e-Masih (A.S) ke qasid gaye the aur us waqt us basti ke log un par iman laye the, balkay yahi woh basti hai jo sari ki sari Janab-e-Masih (A.S) par iman layi, isi liye nasraniyon ke woh char shehar jo muqaddas samjhe jate hain un mein ek yeh bhi hai. Bait-ul-Muqaddas ki buzurgi ke woh qail is liye ke woh Hazrat-e-Masih (A.S) ka shehar hai aur Antakiya ko hurmat wala shehar is liye kehte hain ke sab se pehle yahin ke log Hazrat-e-Masih (A.S) par iman laye. Aur Iskandariya ki azmat ki wajah yeh hai ke unhon ne apne mazhabi ohdedaron ke taqarrur par ijma kiya. Aur Rumiya ki hurmat ke qail is wajah se hain ke Shah Qustuntuniya ka shehar yahi hai aur isi badshah ne unke deen ki imdad ki thi aur yahin unke tabarrukat ko Rumiya se yahan la rakha. Sa'ad bin Batriq waghera nasrani muwarrikheen ki kitabon mein yeh sab waqiyat mazkoor hain. Musalman muwarrikheen ne bhi yahi likha hai, pas maloom hua ke Antakiya walon ne Hazrat-e-Isa (A.S) ke qasidon ki toh maan li thi aur yahan bayan hai ke unhon ne na mani aur un par azab-e-Ilahi aaya aur tehas nehas kar diye gaye, toh sabit hua ke yeh waqia aur hai. Yeh rasool mustaqil risalat par mamoor the, unhon ne na mana jis par unhein saza hui aur woh benishan kar diye gaye aur chiragh-e-sehari ki tarah bujha diye gaye, Wallahu A'lam. Saniyan Antakiya walon ka qissa jo Hazrat-e-Isa (A.S) ke hawariyon ke sath waqoo mein aaya woh qatan Taurat ke utarne ke baad ka hai aur Hazrat Abu Saeed Khudri (R.A) aur salaf ki ek jamaat se manqool hai ke Taurat ke nazil ho chukne ke baad kisi basti ko Allah Ta'ala ne apne asmani azab se bilkul barbad nahin kiya balkay mominon ko kafiron se jihad karne ka hukum de kar kuffar ko neecha dikhaya hai. Jaisa ke ayat (Walaqad ataina Musal-kitaba mim ba'di ma ahlaknal quroonal ula basaira linnasi wahudan warahmatal la'allahum yatadhakkaroon) (Surah Al-Qasas: 43) ki tafsir mein hai aur is basti ki asmani halakat par ayat-e-Qurani shahid-e-adl majood hain, is se bhi sabit hota hai ke yeh waqia Antakiya ka nahin, jaise ke ba'z salaf ke aqwal bhi ise mustasna karke batate hain ke is se murad mashhoor shehar Antakiya nahin. Haan, yeh bhi ho sakta hai ke Antakiya nami koi shehar aur bhi ho aur yeh waqia wahan ka ho. Is liye ke jo Antakiya mashhoor hai uska azab-e-Ilahi se neest-o-nabood hona mashhoor nahin hua, na toh nasraniyat ke zamane mein aur na us se pehle.

Wallahu Subhanu wa Ta'ala A'lam, yeh bhi yaad rahe ke Tabrani ki ek marfu' hadith mein hai ke duniya mein teen hi shakhs sabqat karne mein sab se aage nikal gaye hain, Hazrat Musa (A.S) ki taraf sabqat karne wale toh Hazrat Yusha bin Nun (A.S) thay aur Hazrat Isa (A.S) ki taraf sabqat karne wale woh shakhs thay jin ka zikr Surah Yaseen mein hai aur Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki khidmat mein aage barhne wale Hazrat Ali bin Abi Talib (R.A) thay, yeh hadith bilkul munkar hai. Sirf Hussain Ash'ar isay riwayat karta hai aur woh Shia hai aur matrook hai. Wallahu Subhanu wa Ta'ala A'lam bis-sawab.

Zalimon ke liye Azaab-e-Ilahi. Hazrat Ibn-e-Masood R.A farmate hain ke in kuffar ne us momin-e-kamil ko buri tarah mara peeta, use gira kar uske pet par chadh baithe aur pairon se use rondne lage yahan tak ke uski aanten uske peeche ke raaste se bahar nikal aayin, isi waqt Allah ki taraf se use Jannat ki khushkhabri sunayi gayi, use Allah Ta'ala ne duniya ke ranj-o-gham se azaad kar diya aur aman-o-chain ke saath Jannat mein pahuncha diya. Unki shahadat se Allah khush hua, Jannat unke liye khol di gayi aur dakhla ki ijazat mil gayi, apne sawab-o-ajar ko, izzat-o-ikram ko dekh kar phir uski zaban se nikal gaya: "Kaash ke meri qoum yeh jaan leti ke mujhe mere Rab ne bakhsh diya aur mera bada hi ikram kiya." Fi-al-waqai momin sab ke khair-khwah hote hain, woh dhoke-baaz aur bad-khwah nahin hote. Dekhiye us Allah wale shakhs ne zindagi mein bhi qoum ki khair-khwahi ki aur baad-e-marg bhi unka khair-khwah raha. Yeh bhi matlab hai ke woh kehta hai kaash ke meri qoum yeh jaan leti ke mujhe kis sabab se mere Rab ne bakhsha aur kyun meri izzat ki, toh la-mahalah woh bhi is cheez ko hasil karne ki koshish karti, Allah par iman lati aur Rasoolon ki pairwi karti, Allah un par rahmat kare aur un se khush rahe. Dekho toh qoum ki hidayat ke kis qadar khwahish-mand thay. Hazrat Urwa bin Masood Saqafi R.A ne Janab-e-Rasool Allah ﷺ ki khidmat mein arz kiya ke Huzoor agar ijazat dein toh main apni qoum mein tableegh-e-deen ke liye jaaun aur unhein dawat-e-Islam doon? Aap ﷺ ne farmaya aisa na ho ke woh tumhein qatl kar dein? Jawab diya ke Huzoor ﷺ is ka toh khayal tak nahin. Unhein mujh se is qadar ulfat-o-aqeedat hai ke main soya hua hoon toh woh mujhe jagayenge bhi nahin, Aap ﷺ ne farmaya achha phir jaiye. Yeh chale, jab Laat-o-Uzza ke buton ke paas se unka guzar hua toh kehne lage ab tumhari shamat aa gayi. Qabeela Saqeef bigad baitha, unhon ne kehna shuru kiya ke aye meri qoum ke logo! Tum in buton ko tark karo, yeh Laat-o-Uzza dar-asal koi cheez nahin, Islam qabool karo toh salamti hasil hogi. Aye mere bhai-bandu! Yaqeen mano ke yeh but kuch haqeeqat nahin rakhte, saari bhalayi Islam mein hai waghera. Abhi toh teen hi martaba sirf is kalma ko dohraya tha jab ek bad-naseeb tan-jale ne door se ek hi teer chalaya jo rag-e-akhal par laga aur isi waqt shaheed ho gaye. Huzoor ﷺ ke paas jab yeh khabar pahunchi toh Aap ﷺ ne farmaya yeh aisa hi tha jaise Surah Yaseen wala jis ne kaha tha kaash ke meri qoum meri maghfirat-o-izzat ko jaan leti. Hazrat Ka'ab Ahbar R.A ke paas jab Habeeb bin Zaid bin Aasim R.A ka zikr aaya jo qabeela Banu Mazin bin Najjar se thay jinhein Yamama mein Musailama Kazzab maloon ne shaheed kar diya tha toh Aap R.A ne farmaya Allah ki qasam yeh Habeeb bhi usi Habeeb ki tarah thay jin ka zikr Surah Yaseen mein hai, un se is kazzab ne Huzoor ﷺ ke baare mein daryaft kiya toh Aap R.A ne farmaya beshak woh Allah ke Rasool ﷺ hain, us ne kaha meri nisbat bhi toh gawahi deta hai ke main Rasool-e-Allah hoon? Toh Hazrat Habeeb R.A ne farmaya main nahin sunta.

Munkireen ki nadamat. Bandon par hasrat-o-afsos hai. Bande kal apne upar kaise nadim honge. Baar baar kahenge ke haye afsos hum ne toh khud apna bura kiya. Baaz qiraton mein "Ya hasratan alal ibadi ala anfusihim" bhi hai, matlab yeh hai ke Qayamat ke din azabon ko dekh kar haath malenge ke unhon ne kyun Rasoolon ko jhutlaya? Aur kyun Allah ke farman ke khilaf kiya? Duniya mein toh un ka yeh haal tha ke jab kabhi jo Rasool aaya unhon ne bila-tammul jhutlaya aur dil khol kar un ki be-adabi aur tauheen ki. Woh agar yahan tammul karte toh samajh lete ke un se pehle jin logon ne paighambaron ki na maani thi woh gharat-o-barbad kar diye gaye, un ki dhajjiyan uda di gayin. Ek bhi toh un mein se na bach saka, na is daar-e-akhirat se koi wapas palta. Is mein un logon ki bhi tardeed hai jo dahriya thay, jin ka khayal tha ke yunhi duniya mein marte jeete chale jayenge, laut laut kar is duniya mein aayenge. Tamam guzre hue, maujood aur aane wale log Qayamat ke din Allah ke samne hisab-o-kitab ke liye hazir kiye jayenge aur wahan har ek bhalai burai ka badla payenge, jaise aur aayat mein farmaya: (Wa inna kullal lamma layuwaffiyannahum Rabbuka a'malahum, innahu bima ya'maluna khabir) (Surah Hud: 111). Yani har shakhs ko us ke a'maal ka poora poora badla tera Rabb ata farmayega. Ek qirat mein "lamma" hai toh "in" isbat ke liye hoga, aur "lamma" padhne ke waqt "in" nafiya hoga aur "lamma" ma'ni mein "illa" ke hoga, toh matlab aayat ka yeh hoga ke nahin hain sab magar yeh ke sab ke sab hamare samne hazir shuda hain. Dusri qirat ki surat mein bhi matlab yahi rahega. Wallahu Subhan-o-Ta'ala A'lam.

Wajood-e-Bari Ta'ala ki ek nishani: Allah Ta'ala irshad farmata hai ke mere wajood par, meri zabardast qudrat par aur murdon ko zindagi dene par ek nishani yeh bhi hai ke murda zameen jo banjar khushk padi hui hoti hai jis mein koi rooyidagi, tazgi, hariyali, ghaas waghera nahin hoti. Main us par aasman se pani barsata hoon woh murda zameen jee uthti hai lehlahane lagti hai har taraf sabza hi sabza ug jata hai aur qisam qisam ke phal phool waghera nazar aane lagte hain. Toh farmata hai ke hum is murda zameen ko zinda kar dete hain aur us se qisam qisam ke anaaj paida karte hain ba'az ko tum khate ho ba'az tumhare janwar khate hain. Hum is mein khajooron ke, angooron ke baghaat waghera tayyar kar dete hain. Nehrein jaari kar dete hain jo baghon aur kheiton ko sairab, sarsabz-o-shadab karti rehti hain. Yeh sab is liye ke in darakhton ke meway duniya khaye, kheiton se, baghat se nafa hasil kare, hajatein poori kare, yeh sab Allah ki rahmat aur us ki qudrat se paida ho rahe hain, kisi ke bas aur ikhtiyar mein nahin, tumhare hathon ki paida karda ya hasil karda cheezein nahin. Na tumhein inhe ugane ki taqat na tum mein inhe bachane ki qudrat, na inhe pakane ka tumhein ikhtiyar. Sirf Allah ke yeh kaam hain aur usi ki yeh meherbani hai aur us ke ehsan ke sath hi sath yeh us ki qudrat ke namunay hain. Phir logon ko kya ho gaya hai jo shukr guzari nahin karte? Aur Allah Ta'ala ki be-inteha anginat ne'matein apne paas hote hue us ka ehsan nahin maante? Ek matlab yeh bhi bayan kiya gaya hai ke baghaat ke phal jo khate hain aur apne hathon ka boya hua yeh paate hain, chunancha Ibn-e-Masood (R.A) ki qira'at mein (وَمَا عَمِلَتْهُ اَيْدِيْهِمْ ۭ اَفَلَا يَشْكُرُوْنَ 35؀ۙ) (Surah Ya-Sin: 35) hai. Jaise aur aayat mein hai (وَمِنْ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ خَلَقْنَا زَوْجَيْنِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُوْنَ 49؀) (Surah Az-Zariyat: 49) hum ne har cheez ke joday paida kiye hain taake tum nasihat pakdo.

Gardish-e-Shams-o-Qamar. Allah Ta'ala ki qudrat-e-kamilah ki ek aur nishani bayan ho rahi hai aur woh din raat hain jo ujale aur andhere wale hain aur barabar ek dusre ke peeche ja rahe hain jaise farmaya (Yughshil-lailan-nahara yatlubuhu hasitha) (Surah Al-A'raf: 54). Raat se din ko chupata hai aur raat din ko jaldi jaldi dhoondti aati hai. Yahan bhi farmaya raat mein se hum din ko kheench lete hain, din toh khatam hua aur raat aa gayi aur har taraf se andhera chha gaya. Hadith mein hai jab udhar se raat aa jaye aur din udhar se chala jaye aur suraj ghuroob ho jaye toh rozedar iftar kar le. Zahir-e-ayat toh yahi hai lekin Hazrat Qatadah (R.A) farmate hain ke iska matlab misl-e-ayat (Yulijul-laila fin-nahari wa yulijun-nahara fil-laili wa huwa 'alimun bi-zatis-sudur) (Surah Al-Hadid: 6) ke hai yani Allah Ta'ala raat ko din mein aur din ko raat mein dakhil kar deta hai. Hazrat Imam Ibn-e-Jarir is qaul ko za'eef batate hain aur farmate is ayat mein jo lafz-e-ilaj hai uske ma'ani ek ki kami kar ke dusri mein ziyadati karne ke hain aur yeh murad is ayat mein nahin, Imam sahab ka yeh qaul haq hai. Mustaqarr se murad ya toh mustaqarr-e-makani yani jaye-e-qarar hai aur woh Arsh-e-tale ki woh simt hai pas ek suraj hi nahin balkay kul makhlooq Arsh ke neeche hi hai is liye ke Arsh sari makhlooq ke upar hai aur sab ko ihata kiye hue hai aur woh kurrah nahin hai jaise ke hai'yat daan kehte hain. Balkay woh misl-e-qubbay ke hai jis ke paye hain aur jise farishtay uthaye hue hain insanon ke saron ke upar upar wale alam mein hai, pas jabke suraj falaki qubbay mein theek zohar ke waqt hota hai us waqt woh Arsh se bohat qareeb hota hai phir jab woh ghoom kar chauthe falak mein usi maqam ke bilmuqabil aa jata hai yeh aadhi raat ka waqt hota hai jabke woh Arsh se bohat door ho jata hai pas woh sajda karta hai aur tulu ki ijazat chahta hai jaisa ke ahadith mein hai. Sahih Bukhari mein hai Hazrat Abu Zar (R.A) kehte hain ke main suraj ke ghuroob hone ke waqt Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ke paas masjid mein tha toh aap ne mujh se farmaya jante ho yeh suraj kahan ghuroob hota hai? Main ne kaha Allah aur us ka Rasool hi khoob janta hai, aap ne farmaya woh Arsh-e-tale ja kar Allah ko sajda karta hai phir aap ne ayat Wash-Shamsu... tilawat ki aur hadith mein hai ke aap se Hazrat Abu Zar (R.A) ne is ayat ka matlab poocha toh aap ne farmaya is ki qarargah Arsh ke neeche hai, Musnad-e-Ahmad mein is se pehle ki hadith mein yeh bhi hai ke woh Allah Ta'ala se wapas lautne ki ijazat talab karta hai aur use ijazat di jati hai. Goya is se kaha jata hai ke jahan se aaya tha wahin laut ja toh woh apne tulu hone ki jagah se nikalta hai aur yahi is ka mustaqarr hai, phir aap ne is ayat ke ibtidai fiqray ko parha. Ek riwayat mein yeh bhi hai ke qareeb hai ke woh sajda kare lekin qabool na kiya jaye aur ijazat mange lekin ijazat na di jaye balkay kaha jaye jahan se aaya hai wahin laut ja pas woh maghrib se hi tulu hoga yahi ma'ani hain is ayat ke.

Abdullah bin Amr (R.A) farmate hain ke suraj tulu hota hai usey insano ke gunah lota dete hain, woh ghuroob ho kar sajde mein padta hai aur ijazat talab karta hai, ek din yeh ghuroob ho kar ba-ajzi sajda karega aur ijazat mange ga lekin ijazat na di jayegi, woh kahega ke raah door hai aur ijazat mili nahin toh pahunch nahin sakunga, phir kuch der rok rakhne ke baad us se kaha jayega ke jahan se ghuroob hua tha wahin se tulu ho ja. Yehi Qayamat ka din hoga jis din iman lana mahaz besood hoga aur nekiyan karna bhi un ke liye jo is se pehle iman-dar aur neko-kar na the bekar hoga. Aur yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke mustaqar se murad is ke chalne ki inteha hai, poori bulandi jo garmiyon mein hoti hai aur poori pasti jo jaadon mein hoti hai. Pas yeh ek qaul hua. Doosra qaul yeh hai ke ayat ke is lafz mustaqar se murad is ki chaal ka khatma hai, Qayamat ke din is ki harkat batil ho jayegi, yeh benoor ho jayega aur yeh alam kul ka kul khatam ho jayega. Yeh mustaqar zamani hai. Hazrat Qatada (R.A) farmate hain woh apne mustaqar par chalta hai yani apne waqt aur apni miyad par jis se tajawuz kar nahin sakta, jo is ke raaste jaadon ke aur garmiyon ke muqarrar hain unhi raaston se aata jata hai. Ibn Masood aur Ibn Abbas (R.A) ki qirat "la mustaqar-laha" hai yani is ke liye sukoon-o-qarar nahin balki din raat ba-hukm-e-Allah chalta rehta hai, na ruke na thake, jaise farmaya (Wa sakh-kharalakumush-shamsa wal-qamara da'ibain, wa sakh-kharalakumul-laila wan-nahar) (Surah Ibrahim: 33) yani us ne tumhare liye suraj chand ko musakhar kiya hai jo na thakein na thahrein, Qayamat tak chalte phirte hi rahenge. Yeh andaza us Allah ka hai jo Ghalib hai, jis ki koi mukhalifat nahin kar sakta, jis ke hukm ko koi taal nahin sakta, woh Aleem hai, har harkat-o-sukoon ko janta hai. Us ne apni hikmat-e-kamilah se is ki chaal muqarrar ki hai jis mein na ikhtilaf waqay ho sake na is ke bar-aks ho sake, jaise farmaya (Faliqul-isbah, wa ja'alal-laila sakana, wash-shamsa wal-qamara husbana, zalika taqdirul-azizil-alim) (Surah Al-An'am: 96) subah ka nikalne wala jis ne raat ko rahat ka waqt banaya aur suraj chand ko hisab se muqarrar kiya, yeh hai andaza Ghalib Zi-Ilm ka. Ha-Mim Sajdah ki ayat ko bhi isi tarah khatam kiya. Phir farmata hai chand ki hum ne manzilein muqarrar kar di hain, woh ek judagana chaal chalta hai jis se mahine maloom ho jayen, jaise suraj ki chaal se raat din maloom ho jate hain, jaise farman hai ke log tujh se chand ke bare mein sawal karte hain toh jawab de ke waqt aur hajj ke mausam ko batane ke liye hai, aur ayat mein farmaya us ne suraj ko ziya aur chand ko noor diya hai aur is ki manzilein thahra di hain taake tum saalon ko aur hisab ko maloom kar lo.

Ek aayat mein hai hum ne raat aur din ko do nishaniyan bana diya hai, raat ki nishani ko hum ne dhundla kar diya hai aur din ki nishani ko roshan kiya hai taake tum is mein apne Rab ki nazil karda rozi ko talash kar sako aur barson ka shumar aur hisab maloom kar sako hum ne har cheez ko khoob tafseel se bayan kar diya hai. Pas suraj ki chamak damak is ke sath makhsoos hai aur chand ki roshni isi mein hai. Is ki aur is ki chaal bhi mukhtalif hai. Suraj har din tulu-o-ghuroob hota hai isi roshni ke sath hota hai han is ke tulu-o-ghuroob ki jaghein jaade mein aur garmi mein alag alag hoti hain, isi sabab se din raat ki toolani mein kami beshi hoti rehti hai suraj din ka sitara hai aur chand raat ka sitara hai is ki manzilein muqarrar hain. Mahine ki pehli raat tulu hota hai bohat chota sa hota hai roshni kam hoti hai, dusri shab roshni is se barh jati hai aur manzil bhi taraqqi karti jati hai, phir joon joon buland hota jata hai roshni barhti jati hai, go is ki nooraniyat suraj se li hui hoti hai aakhir chaudahvin raat ko chand kamil ho jata hai aur isi ki chandni bhi kamal ki ho jati hai. Phir ghatna shuru hota hai aur isi tarah darja badarja batadreej ghulta hua misl khajoor ke khushe ki tehni ke ho jata hai jis par tar khajoorein latakti hon aur woh khushk ho kar bal kha gayi ho. Phir ise naye sire se Allah Ta'ala dusre mahine ki ibtida mein zahir karta hai, Arab mein chand ki roshni ke aitbar se mahine ki raaton ke naam rakh liye gaye hain, maslan pehli teen raaton ka naam gharar hai, is ke baad ki teen raaton ka naam nafal hai, is ke baad ki teen raaton ka naam tisa hai, is liye ke in ki aakhri raat navin hoti hai, is ke baad ki teen raaton ka naam ashar hai, is liye ke is ka shuru dasvin se hai, is ke baad ki teen raaton ka naam baiz hai, is liye ke in raaton mein chandni ki roshni aakhir tak raha karti hai, is ke baad ki teen raaton ka naam un ke han wara hai, yeh lafz wara'a ki jama hai, un ka yeh naam is liye rakha hai ke solahvin ko chand zara der se tulu hota hai to thori der tak andhera yani siyahi rehti hai aur Arab mein us bakri ko jis ka sar siyah ho shat-e-dara'a kehte hain, is ke baad ki teen raaton ko zulm kehte hain, phir teen ko zawas phir teen ko darari phir teen ko muhaq is liye ke is mein chand khatam ho jata hai aur mahina bhi khatam ho jata hai Abu Ubaida (R.A) in mein se tisa aur ashar ko qabool nahin karte, mulahiza ho Kitab Ghareeb-ul-Musannaf. Suraj chand ki haddein us ne muqarrar ki hain namumkin hai ke koi apni had se idhar udhar ho jaye ya aage peeche ho jaye, is ki bari ke waqt woh gum hai is ki bari ke waqt yeh khamosh hai. Hasan kehte hain yeh chand raat ko hai. Ibn Mubarak ka qaul hai hawa ke par hain aur chand pani ke ghilaf tale jagah karta hai, Abu Saleh farmate hain is ki roshni us ki roshni ko pakar nahin sakti, Ikrama farmate hain raat ko suraj tulu nahin ho sakta.

Nah raat din se sabqat kar sakti hai, yani raat ke baad hi raat nahin aa sakti balkeh darmiyan mein din aa jayega, pas suraj ki saltanat din ko hai aur chand ki badshahat raat ko hai, raat idhar se jaati hai udhar se din aata hai ek dusre ke ta'aqub mein hain, lekin na tasadum ka dar hai na be-nazmi ka khatra hai, na yeh ke din hi din chala jaye raat na aaye na is ke khilaf, ek jata hai dusra aata hai, har ek apne apne waqt par ghaib-o-hazir hota rehta hai, sab ke sab yani suraj chand din raat falak aasman mein tair rahe hain aur ghoomte phirte hain. Zaid bin Asim ka qaul hai ke aasman-o-zameen ke darmiyan falak mein yeh sab aa ja rahe hain, lekin yeh bahut ghareeb balkeh munkar qaul hai. Baaz log kehte hain falak misl charkhe ke takle ke hai baaz kehte hain misl chakki ke lohe ke paat ke.

Balkay woh misl-e-qubbay ke hai jis ke paye hain aur jise farishtay uthaye hue hain insanon ke saron ke upar upar wale alam mein hai, pas jabke suraj falaki qubbay mein theek zohar ke waqt hota hai us waqt woh Arsh se bohat qareeb hota hai phir jab woh ghoom kar chauthe falak mein usi maqam ke bilmuqabil aa jata hai yeh aadhi raat ka waqt hota hai jabke woh Arsh se bohat door ho jata hai pas woh sajda karta hai aur tulu ki ijazat chahta hai jaisa ke ahadith mein hai. Sahih Bukhari mein hai Hazrat Abu Zar (R.A) kehte hain ke main suraj ke ghuroob hone ke waqt Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ke paas masjid mein tha toh aap ne mujh se farmaya jante ho yeh suraj kahan ghuroob hota hai? Main ne kaha Allah aur us ka Rasool hi khoob janta hai, aap ne farmaya woh Arsh-e-tale ja kar Allah ko sajda karta hai phir aap ne ayat Wash-Shamsu... tilawat ki aur hadith mein hai ke aap se Hazrat Abu Zar (R.A) ne is ayat ka matlab poocha toh aap ne farmaya is ki qarargah Arsh ke neeche hai, Musnad-e-Ahmad mein is se pehle ki hadith mein yeh bhi hai ke woh Allah Ta'ala se wapas lautne ki ijazat talab karta hai aur use ijazat di jati hai. Goya is se kaha jata hai ke jahan se aaya tha wahin laut ja toh woh apne tulu hone ki jagah se nikalta hai aur yahi is ka mustaqarr hai, phir aap ne is ayat ke ibtidai fiqray ko parha. Ek riwayat mein yeh bhi hai ke qareeb hai ke woh sajda kare lekin qabool na kiya jaye aur ijazat mange lekin ijazat na di jaye balkay kaha jaye jahan se aaya hai wahin laut ja pas woh maghrib se hi tulu hoga yahi ma'ani hain is ayat ke.

Abdullah bin Amr (R.A) farmate hain ke suraj tulu hota hai usey insano ke gunah lota dete hain, woh ghuroob ho kar sajde mein padta hai aur ijazat talab karta hai, ek din yeh ghuroob ho kar ba-ajzi sajda karega aur ijazat mange ga lekin ijazat na di jayegi, woh kahega ke raah door hai aur ijazat mili nahin toh pahunch nahin sakunga, phir kuch der rok rakhne ke baad us se kaha jayega ke jahan se ghuroob hua tha wahin se tulu ho ja. Yehi Qayamat ka din hoga jis din iman lana mahaz besood hoga aur nekiyan karna bhi un ke liye jo is se pehle iman-dar aur neko-kar na the bekar hoga. Aur yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke mustaqar se murad is ke chalne ki inteha hai, poori bulandi jo garmiyon mein hoti hai aur poori pasti jo jaadon mein hoti hai. Pas yeh ek qaul hua. Doosra qaul yeh hai ke ayat ke is lafz mustaqar se murad is ki chaal ka khatma hai, Qayamat ke din is ki harkat batil ho jayegi, yeh benoor ho jayega aur yeh alam kul ka kul khatam ho jayega. Yeh mustaqar zamani hai. Hazrat Qatada (R.A) farmate hain woh apne mustaqar par chalta hai yani apne waqt aur apni miyad par jis se tajawuz kar nahin sakta, jo is ke raaste jaadon ke aur garmiyon ke muqarrar hain unhi raaston se aata jata hai. Ibn Masood aur Ibn Abbas (R.A) ki qirat "la mustaqar-laha" hai yani is ke liye sukoon-o-qarar nahin balki din raat ba-hukm-e-Allah chalta rehta hai, na ruke na thake, jaise farmaya (Wa sakh-kharalakumush-shamsa wal-qamara da'ibain, wa sakh-kharalakumul-laila wan-nahar) (Surah Ibrahim: 33) yani us ne tumhare liye suraj chand ko musakhar kiya hai jo na thakein na thahrein, Qayamat tak chalte phirte hi rahenge. Yeh andaza us Allah ka hai jo Ghalib hai, jis ki koi mukhalifat nahin kar sakta, jis ke hukm ko koi taal nahin sakta, woh Aleem hai, har harkat-o-sukoon ko janta hai. Us ne apni hikmat-e-kamilah se is ki chaal muqarrar ki hai jis mein na ikhtilaf waqay ho sake na is ke bar-aks ho sake, jaise farmaya (Faliqul-isbah, wa ja'alal-laila sakana, wash-shamsa wal-qamara husbana, zalika taqdirul-azizil-alim) (Surah Al-An'am: 96) subah ka nikalne wala jis ne raat ko rahat ka waqt banaya aur suraj chand ko hisab se muqarrar kiya, yeh hai andaza Ghalib Zi-Ilm ka. Ha-Mim Sajdah ki ayat ko bhi isi tarah khatam kiya. Phir farmata hai chand ki hum ne manzilein muqarrar kar di hain, woh ek judagana chaal chalta hai jis se mahine maloom ho jayen, jaise suraj ki chaal se raat din maloom ho jate hain, jaise farman hai ke log tujh se chand ke bare mein sawal karte hain toh jawab de ke waqt aur hajj ke mausam ko batane ke liye hai, aur ayat mein farmaya us ne suraj ko ziya aur chand ko noor diya hai aur is ki manzilein thahra di hain taake tum saalon ko aur hisab ko maloom kar lo.

Ek aayat mein hai hum ne raat aur din ko do nishaniyan bana diya hai, raat ki nishani ko hum ne dhundla kar diya hai aur din ki nishani ko roshan kiya hai taake tum is mein apne Rab ki nazil karda rozi ko talash kar sako aur barson ka shumar aur hisab maloom kar sako hum ne har cheez ko khoob tafseel se bayan kar diya hai. Pas suraj ki chamak damak is ke sath makhsoos hai aur chand ki roshni isi mein hai. Is ki aur is ki chaal bhi mukhtalif hai. Mahine ki pehli raat tulu hota hai bohat chota sa hota hai roshni kam hoti hai, dusri shab roshni is se barh jati hai aur manzil bhi taraqqi karti jati hai, phir joon joon buland hota jata hai roshni barhti jati hai, go is ki nooraniyat suraj se li hui hoti hai aakhir chaudahvin raat ko chand kamil ho jata hai aur isi ki chandni bhi kamal ki ho jati hai. Phir ghatna shuru hota hai aur isi tarah darja badarja batadreej ghulta hua misl khajoor ke khushe ki tehni ke ho jata hai jis par tar khajoorein latakti hon aur woh khushk ho kar bal kha gayi ho. Suraj chand ki haddein us ne muqarrar ki hain namumkin hai ke koi apni had se idhar udhar ho jaye ya aage peeche ho jaye, is ki bari ke waqt woh gum hai is ki bari ke waqt yeh khamosh hai. Hasan kehte hain yeh chand raat ko hai. Ibn Mubarak ka qaul hai hawa ke par hain aur chand pani ke ghilaf tale jagah karta hai, Abu Saleh farmate hain is ki roshni us ki roshni ko pakar nahin sakti, Ikrama farmate hain raat ko suraj tulu nahin ho sakta.

Zaid bin Asim ka qaul hai ke aasman-o-zameen ke darmiyan falak mein yeh sab aa ja rahe hain, lekin yeh bahut ghareeb balkeh munkar qaul hai. Baaz log kehte hain falak misl charkhe ke takle ke hai baaz kehte hain misl chakki ke lohe ke paat ke.

Main ne kaha Allah aur us ka Rasool hi khoob janta hai, aap ne farmaya woh Arsh-e-tale ja kar Allah ko sajda karta hai phir aap ne ayat Wash-Shamsu... tilawat ki aur hadith mein hai ke aap se Hazrat Abu Zar (R.A) ne is ayat ka matlab poocha toh aap ne farmaya is ki qarargah Arsh ke neeche hai, Musnad-e-Ahmad mein is se pehle ki hadith mein yeh bhi hai ke woh Allah Ta'ala se wapas lautne ki ijazat talab karta hai aur use ijazat di jati hai. Goya is se kaha jata hai ke jahan se aaya tha wahin laut ja toh woh apne tulu hone ki jagah se nikalta hai aur yahi is ka mustaqarr hai, phir aap ne is ayat ke ibtidai fiqray ko parha. Ek riwayat mein yeh bhi hai ke qareeb hai ke woh sajda kare lekin qabool na kiya jaye aur ijazat mange lekin ijazat na di jaye balkay kaha jaye jahan se aaya hai wahin laut ja pas woh maghrib se hi tulu hoga yahi ma'ani hain is ayat ke.

Abdullah bin Amr (R.A) farmate hain ke suraj tulu hota hai usey insano ke gunah lota dete hain, woh ghuroob ho kar sajde mein padta hai aur ijazat talab karta hai, ek din yeh ghuroob ho kar ba-ajzi sajda karega aur ijazat mange ga lekin ijazat na di jayegi, woh kahega ke raah door hai aur ijazat mili nahin toh pahunch nahin sakunga, phir kuch der rok rakhne ke baad us se kaha jayega ke jahan se ghuroob hua tha wahin se tulu ho ja. Yehi Qayamat ka din hoga jis din iman lana mahaz besood hoga aur nekiyan karna bhi un ke liye jo is se pehle iman-dar aur neko-kar na the bekar hoga. Aur yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke mustaqar se murad is ke chalne ki inteha hai, poori bulandi jo garmiyon mein hoti hai aur poori pasti jo jaadon mein hoti hai. Pas yeh ek qaul hua. Doosra qaul yeh hai ke ayat ke is lafz mustaqar se murad is ki chaal ka khatma hai, Qayamat ke din is ki harkat batil ho jayegi, yeh benoor ho jayega aur yeh alam kul ka kul khatam ho jayega. Yeh mustaqar zamani hai. Hazrat Qatada (R.A) farmate hain woh apne mustaqar par chalta hai yani apne waqt aur apni miyad par jis se tajawuz kar nahin sakta, jo is ke raaste jaadon ke aur garmiyon ke muqarrar hain unhi raaston se aata jata hai. Ibn Masood aur Ibn Abbas (R.A) ki qirat "la mustaqar-laha" hai yani is ke liye sukoon-o-qarar nahin balki din raat ba-hukm-e-Allah chalta rehta hai, na ruke na thake, jaise farmaya (Wa sakh-kharalakumush-shamsa wal-qamara da'ibain, wa sakh-kharalakumul-laila wan-nahar) (Surah Ibrahim: 33) yani us ne tumhare liye suraj chand ko musakhar kiya hai jo na thakein na thahrein, Qayamat tak chalte phirte hi rahenge. Yeh andaza us Allah ka hai jo Ghalib hai, jis ki koi mukhalifat nahin kar sakta, jis ke hukm ko koi taal nahin sakta, woh Aleem hai, har harkat-o-sukoon ko janta hai. Us ne apni hikmat-e-kamilah se is ki chaal muqarrar ki hai jis mein na ikhtilaf waqay ho sake na is ke bar-aks ho sake, jaise farmaya (Faliqul-isbah, wa ja'alal-laila sakana, wash-shamsa wal-qamara husbana, zalika taqdirul-azizil-alim) (Surah Al-An'am: 96) subah ka nikalne wala jis ne raat ko rahat ka waqt banaya aur suraj chand ko hisab se muqarrar kiya, yeh hai andaza Ghalib Zi-Ilm ka. Ha-Mim Sajdah ki ayat ko bhi isi tarah khatam kiya. Phir farmata hai chand ki hum ne manzilein muqarrar kar di hain, woh ek judagana chaal chalta hai jis se mahine maloom ho jayen, jaise suraj ki chaal se raat din maloom ho jate hain, jaise farman hai ke log tujh se chand ke bare mein sawal karte hain toh jawab de ke waqt aur hajj ke mausam ko batane ke liye hai, aur ayat mein farmaya us ne suraj ko ziya aur chand ko noor diya hai aur is ki manzilein thahra di hain taake tum saalon ko aur hisab ko maloom kar lo.

Ek aayat mein hai hum ne raat aur din ko do nishaniyan bana diya hai, raat ki nishani ko hum ne dhundla kar diya hai aur din ki nishani ko roshan kiya hai taake tum is mein apne Rab ki nazil karda rozi ko talash kar sako aur barson ka shumar aur hisab maloom kar sako hum ne har cheez ko khoob tafseel se bayan kar diya hai. Pas suraj ki chamak damak is ke sath makhsoos hai aur chand ki roshni isi mein hai. Is ki aur is ki chaal bhi mukhtalif hai. Suraj har din tulu-o-ghuroob hota hai isi roshni ke sath hota hai han is ke tulu-o-ghuroob ki jaghein jaade mein aur garmi mein alag alag hoti hain, isi sabab se din raat ki toolani mein kami beshi hoti rehti hai suraj din ka sitara hai aur chand raat ka sitara hai is ki manzilein muqarrar hain. Mahine ki pehli raat tulu hota hai bohat chota sa hota hai roshni kam hoti hai, dusri shab roshni is se barh jati hai aur manzil bhi taraqqi karti jati hai, phir joon joon buland hota jata hai roshni barhti jati hai, go is ki nooraniyat suraj se li hui hoti hai aakhir chaudahvin raat ko chand kamil ho jata hai aur isi ki chandni bhi kamal ki ho jati hai. Phir ghatna shuru hota hai aur isi tarah darja badarja batadreej ghulta hua misl khajoor ke khushe ki tehni ke ho jata hai jis par tar khajoorein latakti hon aur woh khushk ho kar bal kha gayi ho. Phir ise naye sire se Allah Ta'ala dusre mahine ki ibtida mein zahir karta hai, Arab mein chand ki roshni ke aitbar se mahine ki raaton ke naam rakh liye gaye hain, maslan pehli teen raaton ka naam gharar hai, is ke baad ki teen raaton ka naam nafal hai, is ke baad ki teen raaton ka naam tisa hai, is liye ke in ki aakhri raat navin hoti hai, is ke baad ki teen raaton ka naam ashar hai, is liye ke is ka shuru dasvin se hai, is ke baad ki teen raaton ka naam baiz hai, is liye ke in raaton mein chandni ki roshni aakhir tak raha karti hai, is ke baad ki teen raaton ka naam un ke han wara hai, yeh lafz wara'a ki jama hai, un ka yeh naam is liye rakha hai ke solahvin ko chand zara der se tulu hota hai to thori der tak andhera yani siyahi rehti hai aur Arab mein us bakri ko jis ka sar siyah ho shat-e-dara'a kehte hain, is ke baad ki teen raaton ko zulm kehte hain, phir teen ko zawas phir teen ko darari phir teen ko muhaq is liye ke is mein chand khatam ho jata hai aur mahina bhi khatam ho jata hai Abu Ubaida (R.A) in mein se tisa aur ashar ko qabool nahin karte, mulahiza ho Kitab Ghareeb-ul-Musannaf. Suraj chand ki haddein us ne muqarrar ki hain namumkin hai ke koi apni had se idhar udhar ho jaye ya aage peeche ho jaye, is ki bari ke waqt woh gum hai is ki bari ke waqt yeh khamosh hai. Hasan kehte hain yeh chand raat ko hai. Ibn Mubarak ka qaul hai hawa ke par hain aur chand pani ke ghilaf tale jagah karta hai, Abu Saleh farmate hain is ki roshni us ki roshni ko pakar nahin sakti, Ikrama farmate hain raat ko suraj tulu nahin ho sakta.

Nah raat din se sabqat kar sakti hai, yani raat ke baad hi raat nahin aa sakti balkeh darmiyan mein din aa jayega, pas suraj ki saltanat din ko hai aur chand ki badshahat raat ko hai, raat idhar se jaati hai udhar se din aata hai ek dusre ke ta'aqub mein hain, lekin na tasadum ka dar hai na be-nazmi ka khatra hai, na yeh ke din hi din chala jaye raat na aaye na is ke khilaf, ek jata hai dusra aata hai, har ek apne apne waqt par ghaib-o-hazir hota rehta hai, sab ke sab yani suraj chand din raat falak aasman mein tair rahe hain aur ghoomte phirte hain. Zaid bin Asim ka qaul hai ke aasman-o-zameen ke darmiyan falak mein yeh sab aa ja rahe hain, lekin yeh bahut ghareeb balkeh munkar qaul hai. Baaz log kehte hain falak misl charkhe ke takle ke hai baaz kehte hain misl chakki ke lohe ke paat ke.

Samandar ki taskheer. Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala apni qudrat ki ek aur nishani bata raha hai ke usne samandar ko musakhar kar diya hai jis mein kashtiyan barabar aamad-o-raft kar rahi hain. Sab se pehli kashti Hazrat Nuh (A.S) ki thi jis par sawar ho kar woh khud aur un ke sath imandar bande nijat pa gaye thay baqi roo-e-zameen par ek insaan bhi na bacha tha, hum ne us zamane wale logon ke aaba-o-ajdad ko kashti mein bitha liya tha jo bilkul bharpoor thi. Kyunke us mein zaroorat-e-akl asbaab bhi tha aur sath hi haiwanat bhi thay jo Allah ke hukum se us mein bitha liye gaye thay har qisam ke janwar ka ek ek joda tha, bada ba-waqar mazboot aur bojh-hal woh jahaz tha, yeh sifat bhi sahih tor par Hazrat Nuh (A.S) ki kashti par sadiq aati hai. Isi tarah ki khushki ki sawariyan bhi Allah ne un ke liye paida kar di hain maslan oont jo khushki mein wohi kaam deta hai jo tari mein kashti kaam deti hai. Isi tarah deegar chopaye janwar hain aur yeh bhi ho sakta hai ke kashti-e-Nuh namoona bani aur phir us namoonay par aur kashtiyan aur jahaz bante chale gaye. Is matlab ki ta'eed aayat (لِنَجْعَلَهَا لَكُمْ تَذْكِرَةً وَّتَعِيَهَآ اُذُنٌ وَّاعِيَةٌ) (Surah Al-Haqqah: 12) se bhi hoti hai yani jab pani ne tughyani ki to hum ne unhein kashti mein sawar kar liya taake ise tumhare liye ek yaadgar bana dein aur yaad rakhne wale kaan ise yaad rakhein. Hamare is ehsaan ko faramosh na karo ke samandar se hum ne tumhein paar kar diya agar hum chahte to isi mein tumhein dubo dete kashti ki kashti baith jati koi na hota jo us waqt tumhari faryad-rasi karta na koi aisa tumhein milta jo tumhein bacha sakta. Lekin yeh sirf hamari rahmat hai ke khushki aur tari ke lambe chode safar tum ba-aaram-o-rahat tay kar rahe ho aur hum tumhein apne thehraye hue waqt tak har tarah salamat rakhte hain.

Kuffar ka takabbur. Kafir-on ki sarkashi, nadani aur anad-e-takabbur bayan ho raha hai ke jab un se gunahon se bachne ko kaha jata hai ke jo kar chuke un par nadim ho jao, un se tauba kar lo aur aayinda ke liye un se ehtiyat karo. Is se Allah tum par raham farmaye ga aur tumhein apne azabon se bacha le ga. To woh is par kar-band hone ke bajaye ek taraf aur munh phula lete hain, Quran ne is jumle ko bayan nahin farmaya kyunke aage jo aayat hai woh is par saaf taur se dalalat karti hai. Is mein hai ke yahi ek baat kya? In ki to aadat ho gayi hai ke Allah ki har baat se munh pher lein. Na us ki tauheed ko maante hain, na rasoolon ko saccha jaante hain, na un mein gaur-o-khauz ki aadat, na un mein qabooliyat ka maada, na nafa ko hasil karne ka malka. In ko jab kabhi Allah ki raah mein khairat karne ko kaha jata hai ke Allah ne jo tumhein diya hai us mein fuqra, masakeen aur mohtajon ka hissa bhi hai. To yeh jawab dete hain ke agar Allah ka irada hota to in gareebon ko khud hi deta, jab Allah hi ka irada inhe dene ka nahin to hum Allah ke irade ke khilaf kyun karein? Tum jo hamein khairat ki nasihat kar rahe ho is mein bilkul ghalti par ho. Yeh bhi ho sakta hai ke yeh pichla jumla kuffar ki tardeed mein Allah ki taraf se ho. Ya'ni Allah Ta'ala in kuffar se farma raha hai ke tum khuli gumrahi mein ho lekin in se yahi accha maloom hota hai ke yeh bhi kuffar ke jawab ka hissa hai. Wallahu A'lam.
