Qayamat ke baad koi mohlat na milegi. Kafir chunke Qayamat ke aane ke qail na thay is liye woh Nabiyon se aur Musalmanon se kaha karte thay ke phir Qayamat ko laate kyun nahin? Achha yeh toh batao ke kab aayegi? Allah Ta'ala unhein jawab deta hai ke is ke aane ke liye hamein kuch saaman nahin karne parenge, sirf ek martaba Soor phoonk diya jayega. Duniya ke log rozmarra ki tarah apne apne kaam kaaj mein mashghool honge jab Allah Ta'ala Hazrat Israfil (A.S) ko Soor phoonkne ka hukum dega wahin log idhar udhar girne shuru ho jayenge. Is aasmani tez-o-tund aawaz se sab ke sab Mahshar mein Allah ke samne jama kar diye jayenge. Is cheekh ke baad kisi ko itni bhi mohlat nahin milni ke kisi se kuch keh sun sake, koi wasiyat aur nasihat kar sake aur na hi unhein apne gharon ko wapas jaane ki taqat rahegi. Is aayat ke mutaliq bahut se aasar-o-ahadees hain jinhein hum dusri jagah warid kar chuke hain. Is pehle nafkha ke baad dusra nafkha hoga jis se sab ke sab mar jayenge, kul jahan fana ho jayega, bajuz is hameshgi wale Allah Azza-wa-Jal ke jise fana nahin. Is ke baad phir jee uthne ka nafkha hoga.

In aayaton mein dusre nafkha ka zikr ho raha hai. Jis se murde jee uthenge. Yansiloon ka masdar naslaan se hai aur is ke ma'ani tez chalne ke hain. Jaise aur aayat mein hai (YAWMA YAKHRUJUNA MINAL AJDAATHI SIRA'AN KA-ANNAHUM ILA NUSUBIN YUFIDUN - 43) (Surah Al-Ma'arij: 43) jis din yeh qabron se nikal kar is tezi se chalenge ke goya woh kisi nishan-e-manzil ki taraf lapke ja rahe hain. Chunke duniya mein inhe qabron se jee uthne ka hamesha inkar raha tha is liye aaj yeh halat dekh kar kahenge ke haye afsos hamare sone ki jagah se hamein kis ne uthaya? Is se qabr ke azab ka na hona sabit nahin hota is liye ke jis haul-o-shiddat ko, jis takleef aur museebat ko yeh ab dekhenge us ki ba-nisbat to qabr ke azab be-had khafeef hi the goya ke woh wahan aaram mein the, ba'az buzurgon ne yeh bhi farmaya hai ke is se pehle zara si der ke liye filwaq'a inhe neend aa jayegi, Hazrat Qatada (R.A) farmate hain pehle nafkha aur is dusre nafkha ke darmiyan yeh so jayenge, is liye ab uth kar yun kahenge, is ka jawab imandar log denge ke isi ka wada Allah Ta'ala ne kiya tha aur yahi Allah Ta'ala ke sache Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmaya karte the. Yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke yeh jawab farishte denge. Baharhal dono qaulon mein is tarah tatbeeq bhi ho sakti hai ke momin bhi kahein aur farishte bhi kahein, Wallahu A'alam. Abdur Rahman bin Zaid kehte hain yeh kul qaul kafiron ka hi hai lekin sahih baat woh hai jise hum ne pehle naqal kiya jaise ke Surah As-Saffat mein hai ke yeh kahenge haye afsos hum par yeh jaza ka din hai, yahi faisla ka din hai jise hum jhutlate the aur aayat mein hai (WA YAWMA TAQUMUS SA'ATU YUQSIMUL MUJRIMUNA MA LABITHU GHAIRA SA'ATIN KADHALIKA KANU YUFAKUN - 55) (Surah Ar-Rum: 55) jis din qayamat barpa hogi gunahgar qasmein kha kha kar kahenge ke woh sirf ek sa'at hi rahe hain isi tarah woh hamesha haq se phire rahe, us waqt ba-iman aur ulama farmayenge tum Allah Ta'ala ke likhe hue ke mutabiq qayamat ke din tak rahe, yahi qayamat ka din hai lekin tum mehez be-ilm ho. Tum to ise anhoni maante the halanke woh hum par bilkul sahl hai, ek aawaz ki der hai ke sari makhlooq hamare samne maujood ho jayegi, jaise aur aayat mein hai ke ek daant ke sath hi sab maidan mein mujtami' maujood honge. Aur aayat mein farmaya amr-e-qayamat to misl aankh jhapkaane ke balkeh us se bhi zyada qareeb hai, aur jaise farmaya (YAWMA YAD'UKUM FATASTAJIBUNA BIHAMDIHI WA TAZUNNUNA ILLABITHTUM ILLA QALILA - 52) (Surah Al-Isra: 52) jis din woh tumhe bulayega aur tum us ki tareef karte hue use jawab doge aur yaqeen kar loge ke tum bahut hi kam muddat rahe. Al-gharaz hukum ke sath hi sab hazir samne maujood. Is din kisi ka koi amal mara na jayega, har ek ko us ke kiye hue a'amal ka hi badla diya jayega.

Jannat ke manazir. Jannati log maidan-e-Qayamat se farigh ho kar jannaton mein ba-sada-e-ikram-o-ba-hazar-e-tazeem pahunchaye jayenge aur wahan ki goona-goon nematon aur rahaton mein is tarah mashghool honge ke kisi dusri janib na iltifat hoga na kisi aur taraf ka khayal, yeh Jahannam se, Jahannam walon se be-fikr honge. Apni lazzaton aur maze mein munhamik honge. Is qadar masroor honge ke har ek cheez se be-khabar ho jayenge, nihayat hashash-bashash honge, kunwari hoorein unhein mili hui hongi, jin se woh lutf-andoz ho rahe honge, tarah-tarah ki raag-ragniyan aur khush-kun awazein dil-furebi se unke dilon ko lubha rahi hongi. Unke sath hi is lutf-o-suroor mein unki biwiyan aur unki hoorein bhi shamil hongi. Jannati mewa-dar darakhton ke thande aur ghane sayon mein ba-aram takhton par takiyon se lage be-ghami aur be-fikri ke sath Allah ki mehmandari se maze utha rahe honge. Har qism ke meway ba-kasrat unke paas majood honge aur bhi jis cheez ko jee chahe jo khwahish ho puri ho jayegi. Sunan Ibn-e-Majah ki Kitab-uz-Zuhd mein aur Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya kya tum mein se koi is jannat mein jane ka khwahish-mand aur uske liye tayariyan karne wala aur musta'idi zahir karne wala hai? Jis mein koi khauf-o-khatar nahin, Rabb-e-Ka'aba ki qasam woh sarasar noor hi noor hai, uski tazgiyan be-had hain. Uska sabza leh-laha raha hai, uske bala-khane mazboot, buland aur pukhta hain, uski nehre bhari hui aur beh rahi hain. Uske phal zaiqedar, pakke hue aur ba-kasrat hain. Is mein khubsurat naujawan hoorein hain aur unke libas reshmi aur besh-qimat hain, uski nematein abadi aur lazawal hain, woh salamti ka ghar hai, woh sabz aur taze phalon ka bagh hai, uski nematein ba-kasrat aur umda hain aur uske mehalat buland-o-bala aur muzayyan hain. Yeh sun kar jitne Sahaba (R.A) the sab ne kaha Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hum iske liye tayari karne aur uske hasil karne ki koshish karne wale hain, Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya Insha'Allah kaho, chunancha unhon ne kaha Insha'Allah. Allah ki taraf se un par salam hi salam hai. Khud Allah ka Ahl-e-Jannat ke liye salam hai, jaise farmaya (تَحِيَّتُهُمْ يَوْمَ يَلْقَوْنَهٗ سَلٰمٌ ڻ وَاَعَدَّ لَهُمْ اَجْرًا كَرِيْمًا) (Surah Al-Ahzab: 44) (Tarjuma) Unka tohfa jis roz woh Allah se milenge salam hoga. Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain jannati apni nematon mein mashghool honge ke upar ki janib se ek noor chamkega, yeh apna sar uthayenge to Allah Ta'ala ke deedar se musharraf honge aur Rabb farmayega (Assalamu Alaikum ya Ahl-al-Jannah), yahi ma'ani hain is ayat 'Salamun qawlan...' ke. Jannati saaf taur se Allah ko dekhenge aur Allah unhein dekhega, kisi nemat ki taraf us waqt woh aankh bhi na uthayenge yahan tak ke hijab hail ho jayega aur noor-o-barkat unke paas baqi reh jayegi, yeh hadith Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai lekin sanad kamzor hai, Ibn-e-Majah mein bhi Kitab-us-Sunnah mein yeh riwayat majood hai.

Hazrat Umar bin Abdul Aziz (R.A) farmate hain Allah Ta'ala jab dozakhiyon aur jannatiyon se farigh hoga toh abr ke saya mein mutawajja hoga, farishtay uske saath honge, jannatiyon ko salam karega aur jannati jawab denge. Qurzi farmate hain yeh Allah ke farman "Salamun qawlan" mein maujood hai. Us waqt Allah Ta'ala farmayega mujhse mango jo chaho, yeh kahenge parwardigar sab kuch toh maujood hai kya mangein? Allah farmayega haan theek hai phir bhi jo jee mein aaye talab karo, woh kahenge bas teri razamandi matloob hai. Allah Ta'ala farmayega woh toh main tumhein de chuka aur isi ki bina par tum mere is mehman khane mein aaye aur main ne tumhein iska malik bana diya. Jannati kahenge phir Allah hum tujhse kya mangein? Tu ne toh hamein itna de rakha hai ke agar tu hukum de toh hum mein se ek shakhs kul insanon aur jinnon ki dawat kar sakta hai aur unhein pet bhar kar khila pila aur pehna odha sakta hai. Balkay unki sab zarooriyaat poori kar sakta hai aur phir bhi uski malkiyat mein koi kami nahin aa sakti. Allah farmayega abhi mere paas aur ziyadati hai, chunancha farishtay unke paas Allah ki taraf se naye naye tohfay layenge. Imam Ibn-e-Jarir (R.H) is riwayat ko bahut si sanadon se laye hain lekin yeh riwayat ghareeb hai, Wallahu A'lam.

Sunan Ibn-e-Majah ki Kitab-uz-Zuhd mein aur Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya kya tum mein se koi is jannat mein jane ka khwahish-mand aur uske liye tayariyan karne wala aur musta'idi zahir karne wala hai? Jis mein koi khauf-o-khatar nahin, Rabb-e-Ka'aba ki qasam woh sarasar noor hi noor hai, uski tazgiyan be-had hain. Uska sabza leh-laha raha hai, uske bala-khane mazboot, buland aur pukhta hain, uski nehre bhari hui aur beh rahi hain. Uske phal zaiqedar, pakke hue aur ba-kasrat hain. Is mein khubsurat naujawan hoorein hain aur unke libas reshmi aur besh-qimat hain, uski nematein abadi aur lazawal hain, woh salamti ka ghar hai, woh sabz aur taze phalon ka bagh hai, uski nematein ba-kasrat aur umda hain aur uske mehalat buland-o-bala aur muzayyan hain. Yeh sun kar jitne Sahaba (R.A) the sab ne kaha Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hum iske liye tayari karne aur uske hasil karne ki koshish karne wale hain, Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya Insha'Allah kaho, chunancha unhon ne kaha Insha'Allah. Allah ki taraf se un par salam hi salam hai. Khud Allah ka Ahl-e-Jannat ke liye salam hai, jaise farmaya (تَحِيَّتُهُمْ يَوْمَ يَلْقَوْنَهٗ سَلٰمٌ ڻ وَاَعَدَّ لَهُمْ اَجْرًا كَرِيْمًا) (Surah Al-Ahzab: 44) (Tarjuma) Unka tohfa jis roz woh Allah se milenge salam hoga. Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain jannati apni nematon mein mashghool honge ke upar ki janib se ek noor chamkega, yeh apna sar uthayenge to Allah Ta'ala ke deedar se musharraf honge aur Rabb farmayega (Assalamu Alaikum ya Ahl-al-Jannah), yahi ma'ani hain is ayat 'Salamun qawlan...' ke. Jannati saaf taur se Allah ko dekhenge aur Allah unhein dekhega, kisi nemat ki taraf us waqt woh aankh bhi na uthayenge yahan tak ke hijab hail ho jayega aur noor-o-barkat unke paas baqi reh jayegi, yeh hadith Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai lekin sanad kamzor hai, Ibn-e-Majah mein bhi Kitab-us-Sunnah mein yeh riwayat majood hai.

Hazrat Umar bin Abdul Aziz (R.A) farmate hain Allah Ta'ala jab dozakhiyon aur jannatiyon se farigh hoga toh abr ke saya mein mutawajja hoga, farishtay uske saath honge, jannatiyon ko salam karega aur jannati jawab denge. Qurzi farmate hain yeh Allah ke farman "Salamun qawlan" mein maujood hai. Us waqt Allah Ta'ala farmayega mujhse mango jo chaho, yeh kahenge parwardigar sab kuch toh maujood hai kya mangein? Allah farmayega haan theek hai phir bhi jo jee mein aaye talab karo, woh kahenge bas teri razamandi matloob hai. Allah Ta'ala farmayega woh toh main tumhein de chuka aur isi ki bina par tum mere is mehman khane mein aaye aur main ne tumhein iska malik bana diya. Tu ne toh hamein itna de rakha hai ke agar tu hukum de toh hum mein se ek shakhs kul insanon aur jinnon ki dawat kar sakta hai aur unhein pet bhar kar khila pila aur pehna odha sakta hai. Balkay unki sab zarooriyaat poori kar sakta hai aur phir bhi uski malkiyat mein koi kami nahin aa sakti. Allah farmayega abhi mere paas aur ziyadati hai, chunancha farishtay unke paas Allah ki taraf se naye naye tohfay layenge. Imam Ibn-e-Jarir (R.H) is riwayat ko bahut si sanadon se laye hain lekin yeh riwayat ghareeb hai, Wallahu A'lam.

Nek-o-bad alaihda alaihda kardiye jayenge. Farmata hai ke nek-karon se badkaron ko chhanat diya jayega, kafiron se keh diya jayega ke mominon se door ho jao, phir hum in mein imtiyaz kar denge unhein alag alag kar denge. Isi tarah Surah Yunus mein hai (tarjuma) jis roz Qayamat qaim hogi us roz sab ke sab juda juda ho jayenge. Yani un ke do giroh ban jayenge. Surah As-Saffat mein farman hai (Ushurul-lazina zalamu wa azwajahum wa ma kanu ya'budun) (Surah As-Saffat: 22) yani zalimon ko aur un jaison ko aur un ke jhoote maboodon ko jinhein woh Allah ke siwa poojte thay jama karo aur unhein Jahannam ka rasta dikhao. Jannatiyon par jo tarah tarah ki nawazishein ho rahi hongi is tarah jahannumiyon par tarah tarah ki sakhtiyan ho rahi hongi unhein bator daant-dupat ke kaha jayega ke kya main ne tum se ahd nahin liya tha ke Shaitan ki na manna, woh tumhara dushman hai? Lekin is par bhi tum ne mujh Rahman ki nafarmani ki aur is Shaitan ki farmanbardari ki. Khaliq, Malik, Raziq mein aur farmanbardari ki jaye mere randa-e-dargah ki? Main to keh chuka tha ke ek meri hi manna sirf mujh hi ko poojna mujh tak pahunchne ka seedha qareeb ka aur sacha rasta yahi hai lekin tum ulte chale, yahan bhi ulte hi jao, in nek-bakhton ki aur tumhari rah alag alag hai yeh jannati hain tum jahannumi ho. Jublan se murad khalq-e-kaseer bahut sari makhlooq hai, lughat mein jabil bhi kaha jata hai aur jublan bhi kaha jata hai, Shaitan ne tum mein se bakasrat logon ko behka diya aur sahih rah se hata diya, tum mein itni bhi aqal na thi ke tum is ka faisla kar sakte ke Rahman ki manein ya Shaitan ki? Allah ko poojein ya makhlooq ko? Ibn-e-Jarir mein hai Qayamat ke din Allah ke hukm se Jahannam apni gardan nikale gi jis mein sakht andhera hoga aur bilkul zahir hogi woh bhi kahe gi ke ae insano! Kya Allah Ta'ala ne tum se wada nahin liya tha ke tum Shaitan ki ibadat na karna? Woh tumhara zahiri dushman hai aur meri ibadat karna yeh seedhi rah hai, us ne tum mein se aksaron ko gumrah kar diya kya tum samajhte na thay? Ae gunahgaro! Aaj tum juda ho jao. Is waqt nek-o-bad alag alag ho jayenge, har ek ghutnon ke bal gir padega, har ek ko us ke namah-e-a'mal ki taraf bulaya jayega, aaj hi badle diye jaoge jo kar ke aaye ho.

Jannatiyon par jo tarah tarah ki nawazishein ho rahi hongi is tarah jahannumiyon par tarah tarah ki sakhtiyan ho rahi hongi unhein bator daant-dupat ke kaha jayega ke kya main ne tum se ahd nahin liya tha ke Shaitan ki na manna, woh tumhara dushman hai? Lekin is par bhi tum ne mujh Rahman ki nafarmani ki aur is Shaitan ki farmanbardari ki. Khaliq, Malik, Raziq mein aur farmanbardari ki jaye mere randa-e-dargah ki? Main to keh chuka tha ke ek meri hi manna sirf mujh hi ko poojna mujh tak pahunchne ka seedha qareeb ka aur sacha rasta yahi hai lekin tum ulte chale, yahan bhi ulte hi jao, in nek-bakhton ki aur tumhari rah alag alag hai yeh jannati hain tum jahannumi ho. Jublan se murad khalq-e-kaseer bahut sari makhlooq hai, lughat mein jabil bhi kaha jata hai aur jublan bhi kaha jata hai, Shaitan ne tum mein se bakasrat logon ko behka diya aur sahih rah se hata diya, tum mein itni bhi aqal na thi ke tum is ka faisla kar sakte ke Rahman ki manein ya Shaitan ki? Allah ko poojein ya makhlooq ko? Ibn-e-Jarir mein hai Qayamat ke din Allah ke hukm se Jahannam apni gardan nikale gi jis mein sakht andhera hoga aur bilkul zahir hogi woh bhi kahe gi ke ae insano! Kya Allah Ta'ala ne tum se wada nahin liya tha ke tum Shaitan ki ibadat na karna? Woh tumhara zahiri dushman hai aur meri ibadat karna yeh seedhi rah hai, us ne tum mein se aksaron ko gumrah kar diya kya tum samajhte na thay? Ae gunahgaro! Aaj tum juda ho jao. Is waqt nek-o-bad alag alag ho jayenge, har ek ghutnon ke bal gir padega, har ek ko us ke namah-e-a'mal ki taraf bulaya jayega, aaj hi badle diye jaoge jo kar ke aaye ho.

A'za-e-badan ki gawahi. Jahannam bhadakti hui aur sholay marti hui cheekhti hui aur chillati hui samnay hogi aur kuffar se kaha jaye ga ke yahi woh jahannam hai jis ka zikr meray Rasool (ﷺ) kiya kartay thay jis se woh daraya kartay thay aur tum unhein jhutlatay thay. Lo ab apnay is kufr ka maza chakho utho is mein kood paro, chunancha aur aayat mein hai (Yauma yud'auna) al-kh, jis din yeh jahannam ki taraf dhakilay jayenge aur kaha jaye ga yahi woh dozakh hai jis ka inkar kartay rahay ho. Batao toh yeh jadoo hai? Ya tum andhay ho gaye ho? Qayamat walay din jab yeh kuffar aur munafiqeen apnay gunahon ka inkar karenge aur is par qasmein kha lenge toh Allah un ki zubanon ko band kar de ga aur un ke badan ke a'za sachi sachi gawahi dena shuru kar denge, Hazrat Anas (R.A) farmatay hain hum Huzoor (ﷺ) ke paas thay ke aap yakayak hansay aur is qadar hansay ke masoorhay khul gaye phir hum se daryaft karnay lagay ke jantay ho main kyun hansa? Hum ne kaha Allah aur us ka Rasool (ﷺ) hi khoob janta hai. Farmaya banda jo apnay Rab se qayamat ke din jhagda karay ga us par. Kahay ga ke Bari Ta'ala kya tu ne mujhe zulm se bachaya na tha? Allah farmaye ga haan, toh yeh kahay ga bas phir main kisi gawah ki gawahi apnay khilaf manzoor nahin karoon ga. Bas mera apna badan toh mera hai baqi sab meray dushman hain. Allah farmaye ga acha yunhi sahi tu hi apna gawah sahi aur meray buzurg farishtay gawah sahi. Chunancha isi waqt zaban par mohar laga di jaye gi aur a'za-e-badan se farmaya jaye ga bolo tum khud gawahi do ke tum se is ne kya kya kaam liye? Woh saaf khol khol kar sach sach aik aik baat bata denge phir us ki zaban khol di jaye gi toh yeh apnay badan ke joron se kahay ga tumhara satyanas ho jaye tum hi meray dushman ban baithay main toh tumharay hi bachao ki koshish kar raha tha aur tumharay hi faiday ke liye hujjat bazi kar raha tha (Nasa'i waghaira). Nasa'i ki aik aur hadith mein hai tumhein Allah ke samnay bulaya jaye ga jabke zaban band hogi sab se pehlay ranon aur hatheliyon se sawal hoga. Qayamat ki aik taweel hadith mein hai ke phir teesray mauqay par us se kaha jaye ga ke tu kya hai? Yeh kahay ga tera banda hoon tujh par teri Nabi (ﷺ) par teri kitab par iman laya tha rozay namaz zakat waghaira ka paband tha aur bhi bohat si apni nekiyan bayan kar jaye ga us waqt us se kaha jaye ga, acha thehar ja hum gawah latay hain yeh sochta hi hoga ke gawahi mein kaun pesh kiya jaye ga? Yakayak us ki zaban band kar di jaye gi aur us ki raan se kaha jaye ga ke tu gawahi de, ab raan aur haddiyan aur gosht bol paray ga aur is munafiq ke saray nifaq ko aur tamam posheeda a'maal ko khol kar rakh de ga. Yeh sab is liye hoga ke phir us ki hujjat baqi na rahay aur us ka uzr toot jaye. Chunkay Rab us par naraz tha is liye us se sakhti se baz purs hui. (Abu Dawood) Hadith mein hai munh par mohar lagnay ke baad sab se pehlay insan ki ba'in raan bolay gi.

Hazrat Abu Musa Ash'ari (R.A) farmate hain ke Qayamat ke din Allah Ta'ala Momin ko bulakar uske gunah uske samne pesh kar ke farmayega, kaho yeh theek hai? Yeh kahega haan Allah sab durust hai beshak mujh se yeh khatayen sar-zad hui hain. Allah farmayega achha hum ne sab bakhash dein, lekin yeh guftagu is tarah hogi ke kisi ek ko bhi is ka mutlaq ilm na hoga is ka ek gunah bhi makhlooq mein se kisi par zahir na hoga. Ab us ki nekiyan layi jayengi aur unhein khol khol kar sari makhlooq ke samne jata jata kar rakhi jayengi. (Ae Sattar-ul-Uyub ae Ghaffar-uz-Zunub tu hum gunah-garon ki parda-poshi kar aur hum mujrimon se darguzar farma. Allah is din hamein ruswa aur zaleel na kar aur apne daman-e-Rahmat mein dhanp le. Ae zarra-nawaz Allah Azza-wa-Jal! Apni be-payan bakhshish ki musla-dhar barish ka ek qatra idhar bhi barsa de aur hamare tamam gunahon ko dho daal, Parwardigar ek nazar-e-Rahmat idhar bhi, Malik-ul-Mulk hum bhi teri chashm-e-Rahmat ke muntazir hain, ae Ghafoor-o-Raheem Allah kya tere dar se bhi koi sawali khali jholi le kar na-umeed ho kar aaj tak loota hai? Raham kar raham kar raham kar. Ae Malik-o-Khaliq raham kar apne inteqam se bacha apne ghusse se nijat de apni Rahmaton se nawaz de apne azabon se chhutkara de apni Jannat mein pahuncha de, apne deedar se musharraf farma. Ameen Ameen). Aur Kafir-o-Munafiq ko bulaya jayega us ke bad-a'mal us ke samne rakhe jayenge aur us se kaha jayega kaho yeh theek hai? Yeh saaf inkar kar jayega aur kadkadati hui qasmein khane lage ga ke Allah Ta'ala tere in farishton ne jhooti tehreer likhi hai main ne hargiz yeh gunah nahin kiye, farishta kahega hayen hayen kya keh raha hai? Kya falan din falan jagah tu ne falan kaam nahin kiya? Yeh kahega Allah teri izzat ki qasam mahaz jhoot hai main ne hargiz nahin kiya? Ab Allah Ta'ala is ki zaban-bandi kar dega, ghaliban sab se pehle is ki dayin raan is ke khilaf shahadat degi, yahi mazmoon is aayat mein bayan ho raha hai. Phir farmata hai agar hum chahte to unhein gumrah kar dete aur phir yeh kabhi hidayat na hasil kar sakte. Agar hum chahte un ki aankhein andhi kar dete to yeh yunhi bhatakte phirte. Idhar udhar raste tatolte. Haq ko na dekh sakte, na sahi raste par pahunch sakte aur agar hum chahte to unhein un ke makanon mein hi mask kar dete un ki soortein badal dete unhein halak kar dete unhein patthar ke bana dete, un ki tangen tod dete. Phir to na woh chal sakte yani aage ko na woh laut sakte yani peeche ko balkay but ki tarah ek hi jagah baithe rehte, aage peeche na ho sakte.

Woh saaf khol khol kar sach sach aik aik baat bata denge phir us ki zaban khol di jaye gi toh yeh apnay badan ke joron se kahay ga tumhara satyanas ho jaye tum hi meray dushman ban baithay main toh tumharay hi bachao ki koshish kar raha tha aur tumharay hi faiday ke liye hujjat bazi kar raha tha (Nasa'i waghaira). Nasa'i ki aik aur hadith mein hai tumhein Allah ke samnay bulaya jaye ga jabke zaban band hogi sab se pehlay ranon aur hatheliyon se sawal hoga. Qayamat ki aik taweel hadith mein hai ke phir teesray mauqay par us se kaha jaye ga ke tu kya hai? Yeh kahay ga tera banda hoon tujh par teri Nabi (ﷺ) par teri kitab par iman laya tha rozay namaz zakat waghaira ka paband tha aur bhi bohat si apni nekiyan bayan kar jaye ga us waqt us se kaha jaye ga, acha thehar ja hum gawah latay hain yeh sochta hi hoga ke gawahi mein kaun pesh kiya jaye ga? Yakayak us ki zaban band kar di jaye gi aur us ki raan se kaha jaye ga ke tu gawahi de, ab raan aur haddiyan aur gosht bol paray ga aur is munafiq ke saray nifaq ko aur tamam posheeda a'maal ko khol kar rakh de ga. Yeh sab is liye hoga ke phir us ki hujjat baqi na rahay aur us ka uzr toot jaye. Chunkay Rab us par naraz tha is liye us se sakhti se baz purs hui. (Abu Dawood) Hadith mein hai munh par mohar lagnay ke baad sab se pehlay insan ki ba'in raan bolay gi.

Hazrat Abu Musa Ash'ari (R.A) farmate hain ke Qayamat ke din Allah Ta'ala Momin ko bulakar uske gunah uske samne pesh kar ke farmayega, kaho yeh theek hai? Yeh kahega haan Allah sab durust hai beshak mujh se yeh khatayen sar-zad hui hain. Allah farmayega achha hum ne sab bakhash dein, lekin yeh guftagu is tarah hogi ke kisi ek ko bhi is ka mutlaq ilm na hoga is ka ek gunah bhi makhlooq mein se kisi par zahir na hoga. Ab us ki nekiyan layi jayengi aur unhein khol khol kar sari makhlooq ke samne jata jata kar rakhi jayengi. (Ae Sattar-ul-Uyub ae Ghaffar-uz-Zunub tu hum gunah-garon ki parda-poshi kar aur hum mujrimon se darguzar farma. Allah is din hamein ruswa aur zaleel na kar aur apne daman-e-Rahmat mein dhanp le. Ae zarra-nawaz Allah Azza-wa-Jal! Apni be-payan bakhshish ki musla-dhar barish ka ek qatra idhar bhi barsa de aur hamare tamam gunahon ko dho daal, Parwardigar ek nazar-e-Rahmat idhar bhi, Malik-ul-Mulk hum bhi teri chashm-e-Rahmat ke muntazir hain, ae Ghafoor-o-Raheem Allah kya tere dar se bhi koi sawali khali jholi le kar na-umeed ho kar aaj tak loota hai? Raham kar raham kar raham kar. Ae Malik-o-Khaliq raham kar apne inteqam se bacha apne ghusse se nijat de apni Rahmaton se nawaz de apne azabon se chhutkara de apni Jannat mein pahuncha de, apne deedar se musharraf farma. Ameen Ameen). Aur Kafir-o-Munafiq ko bulaya jayega us ke bad-a'mal us ke samne rakhe jayenge aur us se kaha jayega kaho yeh theek hai? Yeh saaf inkar kar jayega aur kadkadati hui qasmein khane lage ga ke Allah Ta'ala tere in farishton ne jhooti tehreer likhi hai main ne hargiz yeh gunah nahin kiye, farishta kahega hayen hayen kya keh raha hai? Kya falan din falan jagah tu ne falan kaam nahin kiya? Yeh kahega Allah teri izzat ki qasam mahaz jhoot hai main ne hargiz nahin kiya? Ab Allah Ta'ala is ki zaban-bandi kar dega, ghaliban sab se pehle is ki dayin raan is ke khilaf shahadat degi, yahi mazmoon is aayat mein bayan ho raha hai. Phir farmata hai agar hum chahte to unhein gumrah kar dete aur phir yeh kabhi hidayat na hasil kar sakte. Agar hum chahte un ki aankhein andhi kar dete to yeh yunhi bhatakte phirte. Idhar udhar raste tatolte. Haq ko na dekh sakte, na sahi raste par pahunch sakte aur agar hum chahte to unhein un ke makanon mein hi mask kar dete un ki soortein badal dete unhein halak kar dete unhein patthar ke bana dete, un ki tangen tod dete. Phir to na woh chal sakte yani aage ko na woh laut sakte yani peeche ko balkay but ki tarah ek hi jagah baithe rehte, aage peeche na ho sakte.

A'za-e-badan ki gawahi. Jahannam bhadakti hui aur sholay marti hui cheekhti hui aur chillati hui samnay hogi aur kuffar se kaha jaye ga ke yahi woh jahannam hai jis ka zikr meray Rasool (ﷺ) kiya kartay thay jis se woh daraya kartay thay aur tum unhein jhutlatay thay. Lo ab apnay is kufr ka maza chakho utho is mein kood paro, chunancha aur aayat mein hai (Yauma yud'auna) al-kh, jis din yeh jahannam ki taraf dhakilay jayenge aur kaha jaye ga yahi woh dozakh hai jis ka inkar kartay rahay ho. Batao toh yeh jadoo hai? Ya tum andhay ho gaye ho? Qayamat walay din jab yeh kuffar aur munafiqeen apnay gunahon ka inkar karenge aur is par qasmein kha lenge toh Allah un ki zubanon ko band kar de ga aur un ke badan ke a'za sachi sachi gawahi dena shuru kar denge, Hazrat Anas (R.A) farmatay hain hum Huzoor (ﷺ) ke paas thay ke aap yakayak hansay aur is qadar hansay ke masoorhay khul gaye phir hum se daryaft karnay lagay ke jantay ho main kyun hansa? Hum ne kaha Allah aur us ka Rasool (ﷺ) hi khoob janta hai. Farmaya banda jo apnay Rab se qayamat ke din jhagda karay ga us par. Kahay ga ke Bari Ta'ala kya tu ne mujhe zulm se bachaya na tha? Allah farmaye ga haan, toh yeh kahay ga bas phir main kisi gawah ki gawahi apnay khilaf manzoor nahin karoon ga. Bas mera apna badan toh mera hai baqi sab meray dushman hain. Allah farmaye ga acha yunhi sahi tu hi apna gawah sahi aur meray buzurg farishtay gawah sahi. (Abu Dawood) Hadith mein hai munh par mohar lagnay ke baad sab se pehlay insan ki ba'in raan bolay gi.

Shairi paighambarana shaan ke munafi. Insaan ki jawani joon joon dhalti hai peeri, zaeefi, kamzori aur natwani aati jaati hai, jaise Surah Rum ki aayat mein hai: (Allahu-llazi khalaqakum min da'fin summa ja'ala min ba'di da'fin quwwatan summa ja'ala min ba'di quwwatin da'fan wa shaibatan, yakhluqu ma yasha'u wa huwal 'alimul qadir) (Surah Ar-Rum: 54). Allah woh hai jis ne tumhein natwani ki halat mein paida kiya, phir natwani ke baad taqat ata farmayi, phir taqat-o-quwwat ke baad za'f aur barhapa kar diya, woh jo chahta hai paida karta hai aur woh khoob janne wala poori qudrat rakhne wala hai. Aur aayat mein hai: Hum tum mein se ba'z bahut bari umr ki taraf lautaye jate hain taake ilm ke baad woh be-ilm ho jayen. Pas matlab aayat se yeh hai ke duniya zawal aur inteqal ki jagah hai, yeh paidar aur qarargah nahin, phir bhi kya yeh log aql nahin rakhte ke apne bachpan, phir jawani, phir barhape par ghaur karein aur is se natija nikal lein ke is duniya ke baad aakhirat aane wali hai aur is zindagi ke baad hamein dobara paida hona hai. Phir farmaya na toh main ne apne paighambar ko shairi sikhayi, na shairi us ke shayan-e-shan, na use sher-goi se mohabbat, na sher-o-ashaar ki taraf us ki tabiyat ka mailan. Isi ka suboot aap ki zindagi mein numaya taur par milta hai ke kisi ka sher parhte the toh sahih taur par ada nahin hota tha ya poora yaad nahin nikalta tha. Hazrat Sha'bi R.H farmate hain aulad-e-Abdul Muttalib ka har mard aurat sher kehna janta tha magar Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) is se koson door the (Ibn Abi Hatim). Dalail-e-Baihaqi mein hai ke aap ne ek martaba Abbas bin Mirdas Sulami (R.A) se farmaya tum ne bhi toh yeh sher kaha hai? "Taj'alu nahbi wa nahbal 'abidi, baina al-aqra'i wa 'uyainata". Unhon ne kaha huzoor darasal yun hai "baina 'uyainata wal-aqra'i". Aap ne farmaya chalo sab barabar hai matlab toh faut nahin hota? Salawatullahi wa salamuhu 'alaihi. Suhaili ne Raud-ul-Unf mein is taqdim-o-takhir ki ek ajeeb taujih ki hai, woh kehte hain huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Aqra' ko pehle aur 'Uyaina ko baad mein is liye zikr kiya ke 'Uyaina khilafat-e-Siddiqi mein murtad ho gaya tha, bakhilaf Aqra' ke ke woh sabit qadam raha tha. Wallahu A'lam. Maghazi mein hai ke Badr ke maqtool kafiron ke darmiyan gasht lagate hue huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki zaban se nikla "Nafliqu hama..." (aage kuch na farma sake. Is par Janab Abu Bakr (R.A) ne poora sher parh diya): "Min rijalin a'izzatin 'alaina, wa hum kanu a'aqqa wa azlama". Yeh kisi Arab shair ka sher hai jo Hamasa mein maujood hai.

Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai kabhi kabhi Rasool-Allah (ﷺ) Tarfa ka yeh sher bahut parhte thay: Wa ya'tika bil-akhbari man lam tuzawwidi. Is ka pehla misra yeh hai: Satubdi laka al-ayyamu ma kunta jahilan. Ya'ni zamana tujh par woh umoor zahir kar de ga jin se tu be-khabar hai aur tere paas aisa shakhs khabrein laye ga jise tu ne tosha nahin diya. Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) se sawal hua ke kya Huzoor (ﷺ) sher parhte thay, aap ne jawab diya ke sab se zyada bughz aap ko sheron se tha, haan kabhi kabhi Banu Qais wale ka koi sher parhte lekin is mein bhi ghalti karte, taqdeem-o-takheer kar diya karte. Hazrat Abu Bakr (R.A) farmate Huzoor (ﷺ) yun nahin hai to aap farmate na shair hoon na sher-goi mere shayan-e-shan (Ibn-e-Abi Hatim). Doosri riwayat mein sher aur aage peeche ka zikr bhi hai ya'ni Wa ya'tika bil-akhbari ma lam tuzawwidi ko aap ne Man lam tuzawwidi al-akhbaru parha tha. Baihaqi ki ek riwayat mein hai ke poora sher kabhi aap ne nahin parha, zyada se zyada ek misra parh lete thay. Sahih hadith mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ) ne Khandaq khodte hue Hazrat Abdullah bin Rawaha (R.A) ke ashaar parhay. So yaad rahe ke aap ka yeh parhna Sahaba ke sath tha. Woh ashaar yeh hain:

Allahumma lawla anta ma-htadaina, wa la tasaddaqna wa la sallaina. Fa-anzilan sakinatan alaina, wa thabbitil-aqdama in laqaina. Innal-ula qad baghaw alaina, idha aradu fitnatan abaina.

Huzoor (ﷺ) lafz abaina ko khench kar parhte aur saare hi buland aawaz se parhte. Tarjuma in ashaar ka yeh hai: Koi gham nahin agar Tu na hota to hum hidayat yafta na hote, na sadqe dete aur na namazein parhte. Ab Tu hum par taskeen nazil farma. Jab dushmanon se ladai chir jaye to humein sabit qadmi ata farma. Yehi log hum par sarkashi karte hain, haan jab kabhi fitne ka irada karte hain to hum inkar karte hain. Isi tarah sabit hai ke Hunain wale din aap ne apne khachar ko dushmanon ki taraf barhate hue farmaya:

Ana-n-nabiyyu la kadhib, ana ibnu Abdul-Muttalib.

Is ki babat yeh yaad rahe ke ittefaqiya ek kalam aap ki zaban se nikal gaya jo wazan-e-sher par utra, na ke qasdan aap ne sher kaha. Hazrat Jundub bin Abdullah (R.A) farmate hain hum Huzoor (ﷺ) ke sath ek ghar mein thay, aap ki ungli zakhmi ho gayi thi to aap ne farmaya:

Hal anti illa isba'un damiti, wa fi sabilillahi ma laqiti.

Ya'ni tu ek ungli hi to hai, aur tu rah-e-Allah mein khoon-alood hui hai. Yeh bhi ittefaqiya hai qasdan nahin. Isi tarah ek hadith 'Al-lamam' ki tafsir mein aayegi ke aap ne farmaya:

In taghfirilluhumma taghfir jamma, wa ayyu abdika ma-lamma.

Ya'ni Aye Allah! Tu jab bakhshe to hamare sabhi ke sab gunah bakhsh de, warna yun to Tera koi banda nahin jo choti choti laghzishon se bhi pak ho. Pas yeh sab ke sab is ayat ke munafi nahin kyunke Allah ki ta'leem aap ko sher-goi ki na thi, balki Rabb-ul-Aalameen ne to aap ko Quran-e-Azeem ki ta'leem di thi jis ke paas bhi batil phatak nahin sakta. Quran-e-Hakeem ki yeh pak nazm shayari se manzilon door thi. Isi tarah kahanat se aur ghar lene se aur jadoo ke kalmaat se jaise ke kuffar ke mukhtalif giroh mukhtalif boliyan bolte thay.

Aap ki toh tabiyat in lisani san'aton se masoom thi (ﷺ). Abu Dawood mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ) ne farmaya mere nazdeek yeh teeno baatein barabar hain, tiryaq ka peena, gande ka latkana aur sher banana. Siddiqa (R.A) farmati hain sher-goi se aap ko tab'an nafrat thi. Dua mein aap ko jame' kalmaat pasand aate thay aur is ke siwa chhod dete thay (Ahmad). Abu Dawood mein hai kisi ka pait peep se bhar jana us ke liye sheron se bhar lene se behtar hai (Abu Dawood). Musnad-e-Ahmad ki ek ghareeb hadith mein hai jis ne Isha ki namaz ke baad kisi sher ka ek misra bhi bandha us ki us raat ki namaz namaqbool hai. Yeh yaad rahe ke sher-goi ki qismein hain, mushrikon ki hajo mein sher kehna mashroo' hain. Hassan bin Sabit (R.A), Hazrat Ka'ab bin Malik (R.A), Hazrat Abdullah bin Rawaha (R.A) waghera jaise akabireen-e-Sahaba ne kuffar ki hajo mein ashaar kahe hain. Kalaam mein aise ashaar paye jate hain. Chanancha Umayya bin Salt ke ashaar ki babat farman-e-Rasool (ﷺ) hai ke us ke sher toh iman la chuke hain lekin us ka dil kafir hi raha. Ek Sahabi ne aap ko Umayya ke ek sau bait sunaye har bait ke baad aap farmate thay aur kaho. Abu Dawood mein Huzoor (ﷺ) ka irshad hai ke ba'az bayan misl jadoo ke hain aur ba'az sher sarasar hikmat wale hain. Pas farman hai ke jo kuch hum ne inhe sikhaya hai woh sarasar zikr-o-nasihat aur wazeh saaf aur roshan Quran hai, jo shakhs zara sa bhi gaur kare us par yeh khul jata hai. Taake roo-e-zameen par jitne log majood hain yeh un sab ko aagah kar de aur dara de jaise farmaya (لِاُنْذِرَكُمْ بِهٖ وَمَنْۢ بَلَغَ) (Surah Al-An'am: 19) taake main tumhein is ke sath dara doon aur jise bhi yeh pahunch jaye. Aur ayat mein hai (وَمَنْ يَّكْفُرْ بِهٖ مِنَ الْاَحْزَابِ فَالنَّارُ مَوْعِدُهٗ) (Surah Hud: 17) yani jamaton mein se jo bhi ise na mane woh sazawar-e-dozakhi hai. Haan is Quran se aur Nabi (ﷺ) ke farman se asar wahi leta hai, jo zinda dil aur androoni noor wala ho. Aql-o-baseerat rakhta ho aur azab ka qaul toh kafiron par sabit hai hi. Pas Quran mominon ke liye rahmat aur kafiron par itmam-e-hujjat hai.

Wallahu A'lam. Maghazi mein hai ke Badr ke maqtool kafiron ke darmiyan gasht lagate hue huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki zaban se nikla "Nafliqu hama..." (aage kuch na farma sake. Is par Janab Abu Bakr (R.A) ne poora sher parh diya): "Min rijalin a'izzatin 'alaina, wa hum kanu a'aqqa wa azlama". Yeh kisi Arab shair ka sher hai jo Hamasa mein maujood hai.

Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai kabhi kabhi Rasool-Allah (ﷺ) Tarfa ka yeh sher bahut parhte thay: Wa ya'tika bil-akhbari man lam tuzawwidi. Is ka pehla misra yeh hai: Satubdi laka al-ayyamu ma kunta jahilan. Ya'ni zamana tujh par woh umoor zahir kar de ga jin se tu be-khabar hai aur tere paas aisa shakhs khabrein laye ga jise tu ne tosha nahin diya. Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) se sawal hua ke kya Huzoor (ﷺ) sher parhte thay, aap ne jawab diya ke sab se zyada bughz aap ko sheron se tha, haan kabhi kabhi Banu Qais wale ka koi sher parhte lekin is mein bhi ghalti karte, taqdeem-o-takheer kar diya karte. Hazrat Abu Bakr (R.A) farmate Huzoor (ﷺ) yun nahin hai to aap farmate na shair hoon na sher-goi mere shayan-e-shan (Ibn-e-Abi Hatim). Doosri riwayat mein sher aur aage peeche ka zikr bhi hai ya'ni Wa ya'tika bil-akhbari ma lam tuzawwidi ko aap ne Man lam tuzawwidi al-akhbaru parha tha. Baihaqi ki ek riwayat mein hai ke poora sher kabhi aap ne nahin parha, zyada se zyada ek misra parh lete thay. Sahih hadith mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ) ne Khandaq khodte hue Hazrat Abdullah bin Rawaha (R.A) ke ashaar parhay. So yaad rahe ke aap ka yeh parhna Sahaba ke sath tha. Woh ashaar yeh hain:

Allahumma lawla anta ma-htadaina, wa la tasaddaqna wa la sallaina. Fa-anzilan sakinatan alaina, wa thabbitil-aqdama in laqaina. Innal-ula qad baghaw alaina, idha aradu fitnatan abaina.

Huzoor (ﷺ) lafz abaina ko khench kar parhte aur saare hi buland aawaz se parhte. Tarjuma in ashaar ka yeh hai: Koi gham nahin agar Tu na hota to hum hidayat yafta na hote, na sadqe dete aur na namazein parhte. Ab Tu hum par taskeen nazil farma. Jab dushmanon se ladai chir jaye to humein sabit qadmi ata farma. Yehi log hum par sarkashi karte hain, haan jab kabhi fitne ka irada karte hain to hum inkar karte hain. Isi tarah sabit hai ke Hunain wale din aap ne apne khachar ko dushmanon ki taraf barhate hue farmaya:

Ana-n-nabiyyu la kadhib, ana ibnu Abdul-Muttalib.

Is ki babat yeh yaad rahe ke ittefaqiya ek kalam aap ki zaban se nikal gaya jo wazan-e-sher par utra, na ke qasdan aap ne sher kaha. Hazrat Jundub bin Abdullah (R.A) farmate hain hum Huzoor (ﷺ) ke sath ek ghar mein thay, aap ki ungli zakhmi ho gayi thi to aap ne farmaya:

Hal anti illa isba'un damiti, wa fi sabilillahi ma laqiti.

Ya'ni tu ek ungli hi to hai, aur tu rah-e-Allah mein khoon-alood hui hai. Yeh bhi ittefaqiya hai qasdan nahin. Isi tarah ek hadith 'Al-lamam' ki tafsir mein aayegi ke aap ne farmaya:

In taghfirilluhumma taghfir jamma, wa ayyu abdika ma-lamma.

Ya'ni Aye Allah! Tu jab bakhshe to hamare sabhi ke sab gunah bakhsh de, warna yun to Tera koi banda nahin jo choti choti laghzishon se bhi pak ho. Pas yeh sab ke sab is ayat ke munafi nahin kyunke Allah ki ta'leem aap ko sher-goi ki na thi, balki Rabb-ul-Aalameen ne to aap ko Quran-e-Azeem ki ta'leem di thi jis ke paas bhi batil phatak nahin sakta. Quran-e-Hakeem ki yeh pak nazm shayari se manzilon door thi. Isi tarah kahanat se aur ghar lene se aur jadoo ke kalmaat se jaise ke kuffar ke mukhtalif giroh mukhtalif boliyan bolte thay.

Aap ki toh tabiyat in lisani san'aton se masoom thi (ﷺ). Abu Dawood mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ) ne farmaya mere nazdeek yeh teeno baatein barabar hain, tiryaq ka peena, gande ka latkana aur sher banana. Siddiqa (R.A) farmati hain sher-goi se aap ko tab'an nafrat thi. Dua mein aap ko jame' kalmaat pasand aate thay aur is ke siwa chhod dete thay (Ahmad). Abu Dawood mein hai kisi ka pait peep se bhar jana us ke liye sheron se bhar lene se behtar hai (Abu Dawood). Musnad-e-Ahmad ki ek ghareeb hadith mein hai jis ne Isha ki namaz ke baad kisi sher ka ek misra bhi bandha us ki us raat ki namaz namaqbool hai. Yeh yaad rahe ke sher-goi ki qismein hain, mushrikon ki hajo mein sher kehna mashroo' hain. Hassan bin Sabit (R.A), Hazrat Ka'ab bin Malik (R.A), Hazrat Abdullah bin Rawaha (R.A) waghera jaise akabireen-e-Sahaba ne kuffar ki hajo mein ashaar kahe hain. Kalaam mein aise ashaar paye jate hain. Chanancha Umayya bin Salt ke ashaar ki babat farman-e-Rasool (ﷺ) hai ke us ke sher toh iman la chuke hain lekin us ka dil kafir hi raha. Ek Sahabi ne aap ko Umayya ke ek sau bait sunaye har bait ke baad aap farmate thay aur kaho. Abu Dawood mein Huzoor (ﷺ) ka irshad hai ke ba'az bayan misl jadoo ke hain aur ba'az sher sarasar hikmat wale hain. Pas farman hai ke jo kuch hum ne inhe sikhaya hai woh sarasar zikr-o-nasihat aur wazeh saaf aur roshan Quran hai, jo shakhs zara sa bhi gaur kare us par yeh khul jata hai. Taake roo-e-zameen par jitne log majood hain yeh un sab ko aagah kar de aur dara de jaise farmaya (لِاُنْذِرَكُمْ بِهٖ وَمَنْۢ بَلَغَ) (Surah Al-An'am: 19) taake main tumhein is ke sath dara doon aur jise bhi yeh pahunch jaye. Aur ayat mein hai (وَمَنْ يَّكْفُرْ بِهٖ مِنَ الْاَحْزَابِ فَالنَّارُ مَوْعِدُهٗ) (Surah Hud: 17) yani jamaton mein se jo bhi ise na mane woh sazawar-e-dozakhi hai. Haan is Quran se aur Nabi (ﷺ) ke farman se asar wahi leta hai, jo zinda dil aur androoni noor wala ho. Aql-o-baseerat rakhta ho aur azab ka qaul toh kafiron par sabit hai hi. Pas Quran mominon ke liye rahmat aur kafiron par itmam-e-hujjat hai.

Shairi paighambarana shaan ke munafi. Insaan ki jawani joon joon dhalti hai peeri, zaeefi, kamzori aur natwani aati jaati hai, jaise Surah Rum ki aayat mein hai: (Allahu-llazi khalaqakum min da'fin summa ja'ala min ba'di da'fin quwwatan summa ja'ala min ba'di quwwatin da'fan wa shaibatan, yakhluqu ma yasha'u wa huwal 'alimul qadir) (Surah Ar-Rum: 54). Allah woh hai jis ne tumhein natwani ki halat mein paida kiya, phir natwani ke baad taqat ata farmayi, phir taqat-o-quwwat ke baad za'f aur barhapa kar diya, woh jo chahta hai paida karta hai aur woh khoob janne wala poori qudrat rakhne wala hai. Aur aayat mein hai: Hum tum mein se ba'z bahut bari umr ki taraf lautaye jate hain taake ilm ke baad woh be-ilm ho jayen. Pas matlab aayat se yeh hai ke duniya zawal aur inteqal ki jagah hai, yeh paidar aur qarargah nahin, phir bhi kya yeh log aql nahin rakhte ke apne bachpan, phir jawani, phir barhape par ghaur karein aur is se natija nikal lein ke is duniya ke baad aakhirat aane wali hai aur is zindagi ke baad hamein dobara paida hona hai. Phir farmaya na toh main ne apne paighambar ko shairi sikhayi, na shairi us ke shayan-e-shan, na use sher-goi se mohabbat, na sher-o-ashaar ki taraf us ki tabiyat ka mailan. Isi ka suboot aap ki zindagi mein numaya taur par milta hai ke kisi ka sher parhte the toh sahih taur par ada nahin hota tha ya poora yaad nahin nikalta tha. Chaupayon ke fawaid. Allah Ta'ala apne in'am-o-ehsan ka zikr farma raha hai, ke usne khud hi yeh chaupaye paida kiye aur insan ki malkiyat mein de diye, ek chota sa bacha bhi oont ki nakeel tham le, oont jaisa qawi aur bada janwar uske sath sath hi, sau oonton ki ek qatar ho, ek bache ke hankne se seedhe chalti rehti hai. Is mat-huti ke alawa ba'az lambe lambe mushaqqat wale safar ba-asani jaldi jaldi tay hote hain, khud sawar hote hain, asbab ladte hain, bojh dhone ke kaam aate hain. Aur ba'az ke gosht khaye jate hain, phir soof aur unke balon, khalon waghera se faida uthate hain. Doodh peete hain, bator-e-ilaj peshab kaam mein aate hain aur bhi tarah tarah ke fawaid hasil kiye jate hain. Kya phir inko na chahiye ke in nematon ke mun'im-e-haqiqi, in ehsanon ke mohsin, in cheezon ke khaliq, inke haqiqi malik ka shukr baja layein? Sirf usi ki ibadat karein? Uski tauheed ko manein aur uske sath kisi aur ko shareek na karein.

Nafa-o-nuqsan ka ikhtiyar kis ke paas hai? Mushrikeen ke is batil aqeeday ki tardeed ho rahi hai jo woh samajhte thay ke jin jin ki siwaye Allah Ta'ala ke yeh ibadat karte hain woh un ki imdad-o-nusrat karenge, un ki roziyon mein barkat denge aur Allah se mila denge. Allah Ta'ala farmata hai ke woh un ki madad karne se aajiz hain aur un ki madad toh kuja, woh toh khud apni madad bhi nahin kar sakte, balkay yeh but toh apne dushman ke nuqsan se bhi apne tayin bacha nahin sakte. Koi aur unhein tor maror kar bhi chala jaye toh yeh is ka kuch nahin kar sakte, balkay bol chaal par bhi qadir nahin, samajh boojh nahin. Yeh but Qayamat ke din jama shuda hisab ke waqt apne aabidon ke samne lachari aur bekasi ke sath majood honge taake mushrikeen ki poori zillat-o-khwari ho aur un par hujjat tamam ho. Hazrat Qatada (R.A) farmate hain matlab yeh hai ke but toh un ki kisi tarah ki imdad nahin kar sakte, lekin phir bhi yeh besamajh mushrikeen un ke samne is tarah majood rehte hain jaise koi hazir bash lashkar ho. Woh na unhein koi nafa pohancha sakein na kisi nuqsan ko dafa kar sakein, lekin yeh hain ke un ke naam par mare jate hain yahan tak ke un ke khilaf awaz sunna nahin chahte, gussay se beqabu ho jate hain. Ae Nabi (ﷺ) un ki kufr ki baton se aap ghamnak na hon, hum par un ka zahir batin roshan hai, waqt aa raha hai, gin chun kar hum unhein sazayein denge.

Us ne jawab diya ke sirf tere dar se, Allah Ta'ala ne use bakhsh diya. Hazrat Huzaifa R.A farmate hain Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne rah chalte chalte yeh hadith bayan farmayi jise main ne khud aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki zaban se apne kanon se suni. Samundar ne behukm-e-Allah jo raakh us mein thi use jama kardiya isi tarah hawa ne bhi. Phir Allah ke farman se woh khara kardiya gaya. Phir apni qudrat ke mushahide ke liye aur baat ki daleel qaim karne ke liye ke Allah har shai par qadir hai woh murdon ko bhi zinda karsakta hai, haiyat ko woh munqalib karsakta hai farmaya ke tum gaur karo ke pani mein darakht ugaye sarsabz shadab hare bhare phal wale hue, phir woh sookh gaye aur un lakriyon se main ne aag nikali kahan woh tari aur thandi kahan yeh khushki aur garmi? Pas mujhe koi cheez karni bhari nahin tar ko khushk karna khushk ko tar karna zinda ko murda karna murde ko zindagi dena sab mere bas ki baat hai. Yeh bhi kaha gaya ke murad is se markh aur affar ke darakht hain jo Hijaz mein hote hain un ki sabz tahniyon ko aapas mein ragarne se chaqmaq ki tarah aag nikalti hai. Chunancha Arab mein ek mashhoor misl hai likulli shajarin narun wastajda al-markhu wal-affaru. Hukama ka qaul hai ke siwaye angoor ke darakht ke har darakht mein aag hai.

Allah har cheez par Qadir. Allah Ta'ala apni zabardast qudrat bayan farma raha hai ke usne aasmanon ko aur un ki sab cheezon ko paida kiya. Zameen ko us ke andar ki sab cheezon ko bhi usi ne banaya. Phir itni badi qudraton wala insanon jaisi chhoti makhlooq ko paida karne se aajiz aajaye yeh toh aql ke bhi khilaf hai, jaise farmaya (لَخَــلْقُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضِ اَكْبَرُ مِنْ خَلْقِ النَّاسِ وَلٰكِنَّ اَكْثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُوْنَ) (Surah Ghafir: 57) yani aasman-o-zameen ki paidaish insani paidaish se bahut badi aur ahem hai, yahan bhi farmaya ke woh Allah jis ne aasman-o-zameen ko paida kardiya woh kya insanon jaisi kamzor makhlooq ko paida karne se aajiz aajaye ga? Aur jab woh Qadir hai toh yaqeenan unhein maar daalne ke baad phir woh unhein jila de ga. Jis ne ibtida paida kiya hai us par iaada bahut aasaan hai jaise aur aayat mein hai (اَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا اَنَّ اللّٰهَ الَّذِيْ خَلَقَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضَ وَلَمْ يَعْيَ بِخَلْقِهِنَّ بِقٰدِرٍ عَلٰٓي اَنْ يُّـحْيِۦ الْمَوْتٰى ۭ بَلٰٓي اِنَّهٗ عَلٰي كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيْرٌ) (Surah Al-Ahqaf: 33), kya woh nahin dekhte ke jis Allah ne zameen-o-aasman ko banadiya aur un ki paidaish se aajiz na aaya na thaka kya woh murdon ke zinda karne par Qadir nahin? Beshak Qadir hai balkeh woh toh har cheez par Qadir hai. Wahi paida karne wala aur banane wala, ijaad karne wala aur Khaliq hai. Saath hi daana, beena aur ratti ratti se waqif hai. Woh toh jo karna chahta hai us ka sirf hukm de dena kaafi hota hai. Musnad ki Hadith-e-Qudsi mein hai ke Allah Ta'ala farmata hai ae mere bando, tum sab faqeer ho magar jise main ghani kardoon. Main Jawad hoon, main Majid hoon, main Wajid hoon. Jo chahta hoon karta hoon. Mera inaam bhi ek kalam hai aur mera azaab bhi kalam hai. Main jis cheez ko karna chahta hoon keh deta hoon ke ho ja woh ho jaati hai. Har burai se us Hayy-o-Qayyum Allah ki zaat paak hai jo zameen-o-aasman ka badshah hai, jis ke haath mein aasmanon aur zameenon ki kunjiyan hain. Woh sab ka Khaliq hai, wahi asli hakim hai, usi ki taraf Qayamat ke din sab lautaye jayenge wahi Aadil-o-Mun'im Allah unhein saza de ga. Aur jagah farman hai paak hai woh Allah jis ke haath mein har cheez ki malkiyat hai. Aur aayat mein hai kaun hai jis ke haath mein har cheez ka ikhtiyar hai? Aur farman hai (تَبٰرَكَ الَّذِيْ بِيَدِهِ الْمُلْكُ ۡ وَهُوَ عَلٰي كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيْرُۨ) (Surah Al-Mulk: 1) pas mulk-o-malkoot dono ke ek hi ma'ani hain jaise rahmat-o-rahamoot aur rahbat-o-rahaboot aur jabr-o-jabroot. Baaz ne kaha hai ke mulk se murad jismon ka aalam aur malkoot se murad roohon ka aalam hai. Lekin sahih baat pehli hi hai aur yahi qaul jamhoor mufassireen ka hai.

Hazrat Huzaifa bin Yaman (R.A) farmate hain, ek raat main Tahajjud ki namaz mein Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki iqtida mein khara ho gaya. Aap (ﷺ) ne saat lambi suratein (yani paune das paare) saat rakaat mein parhein. Sami Allahu liman hamidah keh kar ruku se sar utha kar aap (ﷺ) yeh parhte thay: (Alhamdulillah-il-lazi-il-malakuti wal-jaburuti wal-kibriya-i wal-azmati). Phir aap ka ruku ayyam ke munasib hi lamba tha aur sajda bhi misl-e-ruku ke tha, meri toh yeh halat ho gayi thi ke taangein tootne lagein (Abu Dawood waghera).

Inhi Hazrat Huzaifa (R.A) se riwayat hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ) ko aap ne raat ki namaz parhte hue dekha, aap ne yeh dua parh kar phir qirat shuru ki: (Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar, Zil-malakuti wal-jaburuti wal-kibriya-i wal-azmati). Phir poori Surah Baqarah parh kar ruku kiya aur ruku mein bhi qareeb qareeb utni hi der thahre rahe aur Subhana Rabbiyal Azeem parhte rahe. Phir apna sar ruku se uthaya aur taqreeban utni hi der khare rahe aur Li-Rabbil Hamd parhte rahe. Phir sajde mein gaye, woh bhi taqreeban qayam ke barabar tha aur sajde mein Huzoor (ﷺ) Subhana Rabbiyal A'la parhte rahe. Phir sajde se sar uthaya, aap ki aadat-e-mubarak thi ke dono sajdon ke darmiyan bhi utni der baithe rehte thay jitni der sajdon mein lagate thay aur Rabbighfirli, Rabbighfirli parhte rahe. Chaar rakaat aap ne ada keen, Surah Baqarah, Surah Al-Imran, Surah Nisa aur Surah Ma'idah ki tilawat ki. Hazrat Shu'bah ko shak hai ke Surah Ma'idah kaha ya Surah An'am?

Nasa'i waghera mein hai, Hazrat Auf bin Malik Ashja'i (R.A) se riwayat hai ke ek raat main ne Hazrat (ﷺ) ke sath Tahajjud ki namaz parhi. Aap (ﷺ) ne Surah Baqarah ki tilawat farmayi, har us aayat par jis mein rahmat ka zikr hota aap thaharte aur Allah Ta'ala se rahmat talab karte aur har us aayat par jis mein azaab ka zikr hota aap thaharte aur Allah Ta'ala se panah talab karte. Phir aap ne ruku kiya, woh bhi qayam se kuch kam na tha aur ruku mein yeh farmate thay: (Subhana Zil-jaburuti wal-malakuti wal-kibriya-i wal-azmati). Phir aap ne sajda kiya, woh bhi qayam ke qareeb qareeb tha aur sajde mein bhi yahi parhte. Phir dusri rakaat mein Surah Al-Imran parhi. Phir isi tarah ek ek surat ek ek rakaat mein parhte rahe.
